title: US Senior Tax Associate
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

*Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

*Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

description:
High Tide Legal | Remote, Philippines | Hiring within the next two weeks



High Tide Legal is a U.S. law firm that helps business owners protect their brands. We’re looking for a Philippines-based paralegal or legal assistant to support our trademark practice, draft client correspondence, and keep matters moving.



We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates confidently, and brings ideas to the table. If a deadline is approaching, a client hasn’t responded, or you see a better way to handle a recurring task, we want you to speak up and suggest a next step. What you’ll do

- Draft client
s, follow-ups, and matter updates for attorney review.

- Support trademark matters by organizing files, tracking deadlines, preparing materials for attorney review, and following up on outstanding items.

- Keep client records, task lists, and matter statuses accurate and up to date.

- Assist with client intake, onboarding, scheduling, and day-to-day firm operations.

- Bring practical ideas for improving templates, workflows, and the client experience.

- Prior legal work experience is required. Experience supporting trademark matters is a plus.

- Close attention to detail, especially with client names, dates, deadlines, and documents.

- Confidence to ask questions, flag concerns early, and recommend a next step.

- A proactive, business-minded approach and an interest in improving how a small law firm operates.

- Reliable follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities remotely.

Time tracking

Time Doctor is required for this role. You’ll manually start and stop the timer when working on High Tide Legal assignments. Time Doctor captures screenshots during tracked work sessions. If you’re uncomfortable using Time Doctor with screenshots during work sessions, we kindly ask that you do not apply.

Use HTL Legal Assistant | Your Full Name as your application subject line, replacing “Your Full Name” with your name. Attach your résumé as a PDF named FirstName_LastName_Resume.pdf.

 to a client named Maya Rivera. The matter calendar shows December 10 as the deadline, but the attorney’s intake notes say December 12. Maya also hasn’t sent the product photos we requested.

 to Maya asking for the photos. Label the two parts Attorney note and Client
.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
## —About us—



Battling Monsters is the program of Just Care More and primarily follows the stories of Sandra and Jamie: wingsuit BASE jumping, paragliding and alpine climbing, filmed as honest stories about fear, risk and getting back up. We reach about 560,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram,
 and TikTok, with two YouTube videos a month and daily short-form content. Behind the channel is Just Care More, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that uses those stories to reach people who are fighting their own monsters, through its content and impact campaigns in prisons, rehab centres, group homes and schools.



We are a small team and we are growing it: you would be the first hire, followed by a long-form editor whom you will brief and coordinate.



## —The role—



You run our four social networks end to end: strategy, calendar, short-form editing, publishing, community and reporting, and you are the keeper of our footage archive. You are the single point of contact for the channel day to day, so that the founders can focus on filming, partnerships and the nonprofit's impact work. You edit the reels and shorts yourself; a long-form editor cuts the YouTube videos from your briefs. 



## —What you will do—



**Strategy and growth**



- Own and maintain our social media strategy, with a platform-specific plan for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube: how each one grows followers, reach and engagement, and how it sends viewers to YouTube.

- Keep brand guidelines for social media and make sure the voice and messaging are consistent on every platform and support the wider mission: inspiring people facing adversity towards self improvement using adventure sports & adventure travel.

- Research successful accounts, competitor posts, trending topics, sounds and formats, and turn what works into posts and videos of our own.



**Ideas and content development**



- Keep an idea bank of about 100 ideas a month across our reel types (short sport, montage, our story, behind the scenes, motivational, campaign related, YouTube promotional), long form videos and carousels and pick the top potential options for the calendar.

- Mine our content library for content worth developing into videos and posts. You will know the footage better than anyone, because you categorize it (see below).

- Write the hooks and concepts for short-form videos.

- Develop every youtube video: title, thumbnail concept, hook and logline, with A/B/C thumbnail and title tests. Sign off the editor's storyboard before the cut.

- Long-form videos must reach 40% average retention. You own the assets (i.e cover, title), the storyboard sign-off and the feedback loop with the editor that gets them there.

- Give the founders a shoot list each cycle if needed: what the calendar needs filmed, interviews for youtube videos, and which backstories are missing for posts.



**Calendar, production and briefs**



- Build the monthly content calendar in Notion together with the founders: fill it from the idea bank plus executive team must-post items and campaign specific posts, and move each piece from idea to posted. The founders approve the calendar monthly.

- Coordinate the production and posting of two long-form videos a month, about 30 short-form videos a month, daily stories and two weekly photo carousels.

- Keep the production calendar scheduled at least 14 days ahead of today at all times.

- Brief the long-form editor for every YouTube video on the calendar, and specify the platform-specific versions each piece needs.

- Write all copy: captions for every post, titles, descriptions, CTAs, hashtags, in the brand voice.

- Choose the audio for every reel: trending, royalty-free or none. Before anything is scheduled, check that the music choice will not trigger a copyright claim.



**Short-form editing**



- Edit the roughly 30 reels and shorts a month yourself, preferably in DaVinci Resolve, from the content library and incoming footage: hook text on screen, captions, audio, pacing to the hook.

- Story graphics, carousel and photo-post layouts



**Content library and categorizing**



- Own the categorizing and classification of all our content: the existing archive of more than 30 TB and every incoming drop from shoots, so that every clip is described, rated and findable.

- Review and approve the AI categorizing proposals, keep the Content Library current, and flag footage gaps to the founders.

- Know the archive well enough to answer "do we have a shot of X" from memory most of the time.



**Publishing**



- Schedule and publish everything on all four networks through Metricool at our set posting times (7:00 AM and 9:00 AM California time) or the best time per network where the data says otherwise.

- Make sure every post type follows our per-network SOPs (reels, stories, albums, YouTube uploads,
 link posts each have one) for format, tags, links, CTAs and posting rules.

- Daily stories with the right tags, links and CTAs with high engagers saved to Instagram highlights

- YouTube housekeeping: tags, cards, end screens, chapters, playlists.



**Community**



- Reply to comments and DMs on all four networks in our voice, pin strategic comments, moderate spam and hate.

- Count and report the "impact messages" we receive each cycle and pass them to the founders and the PR team. That number is one of our two most important goals to measure impact.

- Escalate important conversations to the founders, and spot people with stories of adversity and transformation who could become part of the wider mission and future podcast. Community management here is more than replying to comments.

- Flag collaboration opportunities that show up in the audience. For example recent followers/subscribers with stories that align with our brand



**Reporting**



- Monitor the analytics and KPIs of all four networks continuously, and call out top-performing and underperforming content as it happens.

- Feed high-performing content back into the idea bank each cycle, scaled up a format: a story that did well becomes a reel, a reel or a day with unusually high engagement becomes a candidate long-form video or topic.

- One short report per 10-day cycle, per network: growth against our 2% target, views, watch time and retention, CTR, saves and shares, impact messages.

- Weekly KPI call with Sandra; feed retention and hook data back to the editors.



**Team**



- Brief and coordinate the long-form editor, plus any occasional freelancers.



## —What we are looking for—



- You have run a multi-network calendar for one brand or creator, ideally in outdoor, adventure or action sports.

- You have managed people and tasks before: freelancers, editors or a small team, with deadlines you were accountable for. You will manage the long-form editor, outsourced thumbnail design and other freelancers as the team grows.

- You write hooks and captions that sound like a person, not a brand.

- You edit short-form video confidently and fast, and can show reels you cut yourself. DaVinci Resolve preferred; if you work in Premiere or CapCut you must be willing to switch.

- You are methodical with large media libraries: naming, metadata, ratings, folder discipline. You will be responsible for more than 30 TB of footage.

- You are fluent in Metricool (or a close equivalent), Google Drive, YouTube Studio and the native platforms of Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.

- You have hands-on experience working in Notion: databases, calendars, templates and briefs, not just notes. Our content calendar and SOPs live there.

- You are organized enough to run a 10-day cycle without being chased, and honest enough to tell us when something is not working.

- You are comfortable with the themes of our content: real risk, fear, injury and recovery, mental health, and the nonprofit's work with people in prisons and rehab.

- English at native or near-native level.

- You can publish during the California morning posting window, and you can work with founders who travel and are sometimes offline for days.

- You own an iPhone and a MacBook (needed to access the social network accounts and our tools) and have reliable internet of at least 30 Mbps.

- You are familiar with AI tools for content creation and social media management, and use them in your day-to-day work.



**Bonus skills**



- Using Davinci Resolve for editing

- Deeper AI experience: building automations for content and social media work.



If you have either, say so in your application and tell us how you have used them.



## —Terms—



- Independent contractor, remote, anywhere in the world.

- approximately 40 hours a week; compensation set monthly salary with monthly bonuses based on performance

- Paid trial task for shortlisted candidates (see below), then a 30-day trial period.

- Start date: start of December 2026, so that your first full cycle runs before the end of the year.



## —How to apply—



1. Links to two accounts or channels you have managed, and your roles and responsibilities with these channels and any accomplishments

2. Links to three reels or shorts you edited yourself, and which software you used.

3. Why you think you are the best fit for this job position

4. What is the biggest suggestion to improve youtube performance of videos and increase views? 

5. Your monthly rate and your location.

6. Confirmation that you have an iPhone, a MacBook and at least 30 Mbps internet, plus any long-form editing or AI experience you want us to know about.



## —Our process—



1. Applications reviewed as they arrive; shortlisted candidates invited to a 30-minute call (late November).

2. you will receive a Paid trial task 

3. Decision and contract first week of December

4. Onboarding and your first supervised cycle in December.

title: YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager
description:
About Us:

Lemuria Citi is a personal brand focused on relationships, intimacy, emotional awareness, self-discovery, and personal growth.



Our content is educational, conversational, thought-provoking, and occasionally playful or provocative. We create meaningful conversations that encourage curiosity, connection, and personal growth.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager to help us produce engaging, high-quality content for YouTube and Instagram.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who can combine excellent video editing skills with creativity, organization, and an understanding of social media growth.



Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

- Edit approximately 1 long-form YouTube video per week (typically 8–20 minutes).

- Repurpose long-form videos into approximately 2 engaging YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels per week.

- Create compelling hooks, clean captions, intentional B-roll, tasteful graphics, and on-screen text.

- Maintain professional audio, color, pacing, and overall production quality.

- Design eye-catching, on-brand YouTube thumbnails and Instagram Reel covers.



YouTube & Instagram Management:

- Write compelling, SEO-optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and chapters.

- Prepare Instagram captions and relevant hashtags.

- Organize content using a shared content calendar.

- Schedule and publish approved content.

- Monitor basic performance metrics and recommend improvements.

- Help identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, retention, and discoverability.



Creative Collaboration:

- Work directly with our Content Manager, who will provide creative direction and final approval.

- Suggest creative ways to make educational talking-head videos more visually engaging.

- Maintain consistent branding across YouTube and Instagram.

- Manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Our Editing Style:

This is extremely important to us.



We are NOT looking for overly flashy editing, constant zoom effects, random stock footage, excessive transitions, or generic AI-generated visuals.



We want someone who can create content that feels:

- Polished, elevated, and professional

- Natural, authentic, and conversational

- Visually interesting without being distracting

- Thoughtful, creative, and intentional

- Modern, clean, and appealing to both men and women



Our videos are primarily educational talking-head content. Your creativity should enhance the message, not overpower it.



We value editors who understand storytelling, pacing, and when to let a powerful message speak for itself.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos and short-form content.

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

- Experience creating high-quality YouTube thumbnails and social media graphics.

- Understanding of YouTube SEO, audience retention, and content optimization.

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram, and Meta Business Suite.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, stay organized, and communicate consistently.

- Comfortable working with educational content discussing relationships, intimacy, sexuality, and personal development.



Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Gling, CapCut, or AI-assisted editing tools is a plus.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, preferably educational, talking-head, or storytelling content.

3. Links to 2–3 YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels you've edited.

4. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you've designed.

5. Your experience managing YouTube and/or Instagram accounts.

6. Your preferred editing software and typical workflow.

7. Your expected hourly rate within our advertised range.



**Please also answer these three questions:**



1. How would you make a 15-minute educational talking-head video more engaging without relying on excessive effects or random B-roll?



2. Describe your process for turning one long-form YouTube video into two compelling Shorts or Reels.



3. Have you managed YouTube or Instagram accounts beyond editing? If so, what responsibilities did you handle, and what results can you share?



We are looking for someone who genuinely understands content creation, not simply someone who can cut and assemble footage.



If you're a creative editor who values storytelling, quality, and thoughtful collaboration, we'd love to see your work!

title: VIDEO EDITOR – ONLINE WEBINARS (talking head + slides) & Educational Videos
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

AccrediPro University produces educational webinars and course videos for health professionals every month. We are looking for one/two editors for a long-term collaboration.



THE WORK

Webinars of 60–80 minutes, recorded as short clips by a host and two experts. You put them together with the slides, following our step-by-step guide: what goes on screen is already written down for every clip.



WHAT WE EXPECT

Clean cuts: only the scripted lines, with no false starts, repeated takes or long pauses.

Clear, even audio for every speaker.

Slides and speakers exactly as the guide says, with slide elements appearing in time with the voice.

A simple, professional result: no music, effects, filters, subtitles or watermarks.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Look at the example folder: 
/drive/folders/1rGUHiAJxlw0MIlKCQWBOcjiSJEJ1BFQV

It holds the first 10 of the 80 slides of one webinar (about 7 minutes), with the clips and our guide, so you can see what the work involves. Do not edit it before we confirm your test.



2. Reply starting with the word "SLIDES" and send us:

Links to 2–3 original videos you edited yourself, ideally with speakers and slides;

The software and equipment you use

Whether, after seeing the example, you can deliver this work at a professional level.

Applications without the word "SLIDES" or without these details are not considered.



TERMS

If we accept your application, we confirm the test in writing: you edit the first 10 slides of the example folder as a finished video, paid $5. If the test is not accepted, you still receive the $5 and the selection ends.



Good test: we sign an agreement, have a short call to show you all the pending work, and commission the full webinar.



From the second webinar on, every job (webinars and educational videos) has a fixed fee agreed in advance, plus a final bonus. There is new work every month, plus a large backlog.



The test is paid only after our written confirmation. OnlineJobs rules do not allow us to ask for free samples, even short ones. 

If you do the test on your own initiative without our go-ahead, the responsibility is yours.



Payment is made by a US company through Wise. You need a Wise account with USD account details, and you must give us the full name on the account, the account number and the routing number. Accounts in Philippine pesos only are not accepted.



This ad stays up while the positions are open.

title: VIDEO EDITOR – ONLINE WEBINARS (talking head + slides) & Educational Videos
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

AccrediPro University produces educational webinars and course videos for health professionals every month. We are looking for one/two editors for a long-term collaboration.



THE WORK

Webinars of 60–80 minutes, recorded as short clips by a host and two experts. You put them together with the slides, following our step-by-step guide: what goes on screen is already written down for every clip.



WHAT WE EXPECT

Clean cuts: only the scripted lines, with no false starts, repeated takes or long pauses.

Clear, even audio for every speaker.

Slides and speakers exactly as the guide says, with slide elements appearing in time with the voice.

A simple, professional result: no music, effects, filters, subtitles or watermarks.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Look at the example folder: 
/drive/folders/1rGUHiAJxlw0MIlKCQWBOcjiSJEJ1BFQV

It holds the first 10 of the 80 slides of one webinar (about 7 minutes), with the clips and our guide, so you can see what the work involves. Do not edit it before we confirm your test.



2. Reply starting with the word "SLIDES" and send us:

Links to 2–3 original videos you edited yourself, ideally with speakers and slides;

The software and equipment you use

Whether, after seeing the example, you can deliver this work at a professional level.

Applications without the word "SLIDES" or without these details are not considered.



TERMS

If we accept your application, we confirm the test in writing: you edit the first 10 slides of the example folder as a finished video, paid $5. If the test is not accepted, you still receive the $5 and the selection ends.



Good test: we sign an agreement, have a short call to show you all the pending work, and commission the full webinar.



From the second webinar on, every job (webinars and educational videos) has a fixed fee agreed in advance, plus a final bonus. There is new work every month, plus a large backlog.



The test is paid only after our written confirmation. OnlineJobs rules do not allow us to ask for free samples, even short ones. 

If you do the test on your own initiative without our go-ahead, the responsibility is yours.



Payment is made by a US company through Wise. You need a Wise account with USD account details, and you must give us the full name on the account, the account number and the routing number. Accounts in Philippine pesos only are not accepted.



This ad stays up while the positions are open.

title: Social Media and Content Manager
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the short-form content engine of established, fast-growing **founder-led brands**. You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms. Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.





***Role Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing & Content Packaging

- Transform raw talking-head and b-roll footage into engaging short-form videos with strong hooks, tight pacing, clean cuts, captions, and visual emphasis.

- Edit platform-native videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other short-form content channels.

- Create multiple short-form formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, educational videos, founder-brand reels, and promotional clips.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, moments, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

-- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.



Tracking & Reporting

- Generate regular reports on content performance, audience growth, engagement, and short-form video results.

- Track key metrics such as views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- Identify which hooks, formats, topics, editing styles, and visuals are performing best.

- Provide clear insights and recommendations to improve future content performance.

- Use AI to make reporting, performance analysis, and repeatable content workflows faster and more efficient.



Role Requirements:

- - Minimum 3 years of virtual work experience in social media management, content management, or short-form video editing.

- Strong short-form video editing portfolio, especially for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and founder-led personal brands.

- Proven ability to transform raw talking-head footage, b-roll, event clips, and long-form recordings into polished, engaging, high-performing short-form videos.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, sound design, b-roll usage, visual hierarchy, storytelling, and platform-native editing styles.

- Ability to create multiple content formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, carousel posts, educational videos, and promotional clips.

- Proficient in tools such as CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Opus, or similar.

- Excellent English, strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, creative judgment, visual taste, and the ability to work independently with founder-led brands.



Role Results (KPIs)

- - 100% adherence to the content production calendar, including edited, approved, and scheduled short-form videos.

- Consistently strong QA pass rate on submitted content, with minimal captioning, formatting, audio, export, factual, or brand-alignment errors.

- Efficient production of high-quality short-form video edits from raw talking-head footage, b-roll, long-form videos, events, and other raw content assets.

- Consistent improvement in short-form video quality, including stronger hooks, sharper pacing, cleaner edits, better visual polish, and stronger brand alignment.

- Increased short-form content performance across views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- <30-minute response time to social media comments, messages, and mentions during agreed working hours.

- Accurate reporting of content performance metrics with clear insights and recommendations to improve future content.



**Work Schedule

- You will either be hired on a part-time (20hour / week) or full-time (40hour / week) basis

- Shift times would be based on the founder’s timezone, which can be across North American, European, or Australia/Asia Pacific times.

- Availability may be required around key content publishing windows, campaign launches, or time-sensitive social media engagement periods.



**Compensation

- Competitive hourly rate

- Quarterly bonus eligibility, up to 800 USD or more per year.

- Pay rise potential based on experience and performance.

- Opportunity for higher one-off project fees on top of standard salary.

- Work-from-home flexibility.

- Access to training and career development.

- Work alongside high-performing virtual teams and world-class Founders.



***Apply Here

???? 



Please do NOT private message us regarding this job. We have a hiring process in place and will only accept applicants who can follow the process.



Place the word "I am" at the start of your full name in the application form.

title: Data-Driven Social Media CRM & Marketing Operations Specialist (Direct Hire)
description:
Job Overview

Are you a systems-driven digital marketer who loves organizing chaos into clean data? Do you get excited about building workflows, tracking campaign performance, and ensuring no lead falls through the cracks? If you prefer analyzing spreadsheets and setting up CRM automations over just designing pretty graphics, we want you.

We are an expanding business looking for a high-level Marketing Operations & Social Media CRM Virtual Assistant. This is a long-term, direct-hire position (no agencies). You will own our data pipelines, making sure that every lead generated from our social media campaigns is organized, tracked, and ready to be used for our marketing growth.

Responsibilities

CRM & Database Management: Build and maintain our central source of truth (HubSpot/Airtable/Google Sheets) to track leads, audience demographics, and social media campaign performance.

Workflow Automation: Set up and manage automation bridges (Zapier/Make) to connect our social media platforms and DM automation tools (ManyChat) directly to our CRM.

Data Organization for Marketing: Segment our audience lists based on past behavior, engagement levels, and ad campaign source so we can use the data for retargeting and email marketing.

Campaign Tracking & Analytics: Pull daily/weekly raw data from
 Ads Manager, TikTok, and organic channels. Clean up the data, organize it into dashboards, and provide insights on what is working.

Lead Cleanliness: Ensure data integrity by regularly deduplicating lists, fixing broken tracking links, and updating lead statuses.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

The Filter Word: To prove you pay attention to detail, you must start your application message with the phrase "Data-Driven Systems" in the subject line or first sentence. Applications without this will be deleted immediately.

Systems Experience: Proven experience setting up and managing CRMs (like HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or highly customized Airtable systems).

Automation Savvy: Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Zapier or Make.com (you know how to troubleshoot a broken webhook).

Social Funnel Knowledge: Familiarity with Meta Business Suite,
 Lead Forms, and DM automation tools like ManyChat.

Data Fluency: Advanced skills in Google Sheets/Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data sorting, and cleaning raw CSV files are second nature to you).

Reliability: A reliable workspace with a high-speed internet connection and a backup power solution.

What We Offer

Direct Hire Stability: Work directly with the business owner. No agency middlemen taking a cut of your pay.

Competitive Salary: [Insert Salary Range, e.g., $600 - $1,000 USD / Php 35,000 - Php 58,000] per month, depending on your actual technical experience.

Flexible/Consistent Hours: [Specify if it is full-time or part-time, and if it is fixed-shift or flexible hours].

Loyalty Bonus: We respect Filipino workplace traditions and offer a pro-rated 13th-month bonus in December for exceptional performance.

Growth Potential: As our data systems grow, your role and compensation have the room to grow into a Marketing Operations Manager position.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the perfect fit for your analytical mind, please apply with:

A brief summary of your experience managing CRMs and marketing data.

An example of an automation workflow or tracking dashboard you have built in the past (you can blur out sensitive client data).

A link to a 1-to-2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and telling us why you prefer marketing data over basic administrative tasks.

title: Graphic Designer & Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Graphic Designer & Digital Marketing Assistant



Spotguide | Full Time / Internship Opportunity



About the Role



Spotguide is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Digital Marketing Assistant to support our design and digital marketing efforts.



We're open to experienced applicants, designers, and students looking for internship opportunities. We value practical skills, creativity, and a strong portfolio over years of experience alone.



Responsibilities



- Create high-quality graphics and marketing materials using Adobe Photoshop and Canva.

- Design social media posts, promotional materials, advertisements, and other branded assets.

- Set up and manage Meta Ads campaigns, including campaign objectives, audience targeting, budget allocation, ad placements, and scheduling.

- Manage campaign budgets, monitor ad spend, and track key performance metrics such as reach, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, and ROAS.

- Optimize campaigns by analyzing performance data, testing ad creatives and audiences, and adjusting budgets and targeting to improve results.

- Maintain consistent branding across all marketing materials and advertising creatives.

- Follow creative briefs, incorporate feedback, and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.

- Collaborate with the team on marketing initiatives, campaign execution, and performance reporting.



Requirements:



Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Canva.

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and paid social advertising.

A strong portfolio showcasing relevant design work.

Good visual design skills and attention to detail.

Ability to follow instructions, accept feedback, and work independently.

Reliable communication and good time management.

Willingness to complete assigned work personally rather than outsource it.



Students and internship applicants are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate the required skills through their portfolio and practical work.



Compensation



The compensation range is to be determined based on the candidate's skills, experience, and overall fit.

Please include your desired hourly rate in your application so we can assess whether expectations align.



Application Process

title: Experienced E-commerce Marketing & Product Launch Specialist (Shopify + AI)
description:
E-commerce Marketing & Product Launch Specialist | $1,500-$2,000 USD/Month | Full-Time



I'm an e-commerce entrepreneur who previously built and successfully exited a seven-figure DTC brand. I'm now building my next business and looking for an experienced e-commerce specialist to work directly alongside me.



Our focus is rapidly launching and testing products, identifying winners and scaling them into successful brands.



This is not an entry-level VA position. I'm looking for someone who already understands e-commerce, takes initiative and can execute independently.



**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**



- Conduct product, competitor and customer research.

- Identify customer avatars, desires, pain points and marketing angles.

- Build complete, conversion-focused Shopify product pages.

- Write direct-response marketing copy.

- Generate high-quality product imagery and marketing assets using AI.

- Build advertorials, listicles and landing pages.

- Assist with static and video advertising creatives.



Our goal is to launch a new product every 1-2 working days while maintaining high standards.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- 2+ years of experience working with DTC e-commerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong Shopify and landing page development skills.

- Understanding of direct-response marketing and copywriting.

- Excellent visual taste and graphic design skills.

- Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and AI image generation.

- Excellent written English.

- Ability to work quickly, independently and with minimal supervision.



Familiarity with Eugene Schwartz's Breakthrough Advertising is a significant advantage.



You will be provided with research frameworks, templates, SOPs, brand guidelines and the necessary software.



**COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY**



- $1,500-$2,000 USD/month, depending on experience.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- Fully remote.

- Long-term opportunity with performance-based salary increases.

- Potential to progress into a Brand Manager position as we scale.



Shortlisted candidates will complete an 8-hour paid practical assessment ($100 USD). The successful candidate will then begin a fully paid 30-day trial.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Please include:



1. A brief summary of your e-commerce experience.

2. Links to Shopify product pages, landing pages or advertorials you have personally built.

3. Examples of product imagery and advertising creatives you have created.

4. The AI tools you regularly use.

5. Your expected salary and earliest available start date.



I'm looking for someone ambitious who wants to grow alongside the business, take on increasing responsibility and eventually become a key member of the team.



Please DO NOT apply without relevant e-commerce experience and portfolio examples.

title: Virtual Assistant (App Developer / Content Creator / Graphic Designer)
description:
Job Description: Content Creator & App Builder

About the Brand

We are a personal brand and real estate business built around a real story: a single mom of three boys breaking into the real estate world, and building a referral business for coaches and athletes who are moving and relocating. The founder has a strong personal brand, a clear vision, and a growing audience. We are growing fast and we need one exceptional person to own the content side and build our community app.

Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, X 
, [others] Content style: Lifestyle, real estate journey, relocation and referral content, family life Stage: Active and growing. This is a brand with direction and momentum, not a startup still feeling its way.

The Role

The founder provides the raw material: photos, videos, and real-life moments. You build the vision from there.

This means owning the content calendar, coming up with post ideas, editing and designing to completion, writing captions, choosing music, researching hashtags, publishing, and tracking performance. You will also build our app, manage our contacts, and be the first friendly voice our clients hear. You bring the creative direction. You flag what you need before it becomes a problem. You work ahead, not behind.

This is not a task-execution role. We are not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We need a creative strategist and builder who takes raw assets and turns them into a content plan, then sees it through to posting without hand-holding.

First priority: the app. Your first job is to design and build our app, based on our GroupMe chat and our website. Content creation, contacts, and client experience start alongside it, but the app comes first.

Urgent: This is an urgent hire. We need the app successfully completed, with all review comments cleared, by Friday, November 27, 2026 at close of business EST. You are paid hourly for all your work, plus a $40 bonus for successful completion by the deadline.

Big goal: brand deals. We want to secure brand deals, and your content, views, and outreach are how we get there. Your pay grows with the results you deliver.

Hours: 20- 30 hours per week, with flexibility to work more during busier periods. Availability: Flexible on the hours that the VA works independently, however, this person must be available for calls / meetings / feedback, as needed, between 10am-12pm EST  Rate: Starting at $5.00 per hour + Incentive-based compensation: On top of your hourly rate, you earn incentive-based compensation for completing the app on time, securing brand deals, content that goes viral, and views. The more results you deliver, the more you earn. Tools: You provide your own tools. Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, and standard scheduling platforms is expected. Start: Immediate. This is an urgent hire.

What You Will Do

1. App Build (First Priority)

•      Design and build our app first, using our GroupMe chat and our website as the foundation.

•      Study the GroupMe chat: how members communicate, the topics and questions that come up most, the shared resources, and how the group is organized. Use this to d
 the app's features, such as group chats or channels, announcements, a resource library, and a member directory.

•      Review our website: its branding, colors, pages, wording, and offerings. Bring these into the app so the website and app look and feel like one brand.

•      Help move our GroupMe members into the app with a clear, friendly invite and sign-up process.

•      Research the Ladies Playbook app for feature ideas and create a feature list of what we want, confirmed with the founder before building.

•      Build on a no-code or low-code platform (such as Glide, Softr, Bubble, or Adalo), recommending the best one for our budget and goals.

•      Set up core features such as sign-up and login, member profiles, a directory or listings, categories, search, and notifications.

•      Create original branding, layout, wording, and content. We want the same type of experience, not a copy of another company's name, logo, text, images, or code.

•      Test on iPhone and Android, fix bugs, prepare for launch, and maintain and update the app afterward.

2. Content Strategy and Calendar Ownership

•      Build the monthly content calendar from scratch, informed by what is trending, what aligns with our three content pillars, and what will perform on each platform.

•      Plan 3 posts per week, scheduled during each platform's peak engagement hours, and confirm those hours using platform analytics.

•      Rotate through the three pillars, roughly one of each per week:

a.     Real estate journey: behind-the-scenes moments, wins, lessons learned, and day-in-the-life posts.

b.     Referral business for coaches and athletes: relocation tips, success stories, and clear calls to action for referrals.

c.      Family lifestyle: authentic content showing life as a single mom of three boys, balancing family and business.

•      Bring ideas proactively. Do not wait to be asked.

•      Flag asset needs clearly and in advance, never at the last minute.

3. Content Creation and Editing

•      Take the photos and videos provided by the founder and produce polished, on-brand content: Reels, carousels, static posts, stories, and TikToks.

•      Write captions and scripts in the founder's voice, with hooks that stop the scroll and calls to action that convert. Select music and research hashtags.

•      Submit the full month's content (posts, captions, and tweets) for approval by [date each month, such as the 25th] for the following month. Nothing is posted until it is approved.

•      Deliver on time, every time. Fast turnaround is non-negotiable.

4. Publishing, Engagement and Performance

•      Publish and schedule content across all platforms.

•      Tweet daily from our X 
) 
 short posts, thoughts, tips, and conversation starters that follow our three content pillars and match the founder's voice. Draft each month's tweets in advance and include them in the monthly approval.

•      Engage on X every day: reply to followers, join relevant conversations, and share our Instagram and TikTok content and the app. Reactive or real-time tweets only follow agreed guidelines or approval.

•      Respond to comments, DMs, and mentions within [24 hours], and flag anything urgent or sensitive.

•      Monitor post performance and report back every week on followers, reach, engagement, and app sign-ups. Flag what is working and what is not, and recommend next steps.

•      Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm updates, and trending audio.

5. Contacts and Client Experience

•      Transfer all existing contacts into one organized database or CRM, clean and edit records, remove duplicates, and tag contacts by category (clients, members, leads, partners). Keep the database current and backed up.

•      Be the first point of contact for new leads and referrals from social media, the app, and DMs, responding within [24 hours] in a warm, professional tone that matches our brand.

•      Welcome new clients with a friendly onboarding message and clear next steps, including coaches and athletes who are relocating.

•      Track each client's stage (new lead, in contact, working together, closed) and follow up at key points: after first contact, during the move or home search, and after closing with a thank-you and a request for a review or referral.

•      Collect client feedback and testimonials (with permission) and turn them into content.

•      Pass anything involving contracts, pricing, or legal or financial matters straight to the founder.

6. Brand Deals and Partnerships

•      Research brands that fit our audience, such as relocation, moving, home, lifestyle, family, and athletic and coaching brands.

•      Draft pitches to moving companies, with a focus on securing promo codes for our community and business partnerships that benefit both sides.

•      Build a media kit and pitch deck with our audience numbers, views, and best content examples.

•      Write outreach messages, send them, follow up, and track every opportunity, promo code, and partnership in a simple pipeline.

•      Set up and manage our presence on UGC and creator platforms where brands look for creators.

•      Create and publish sponsored content once a deal is secured, and report on its results.

•      Pass pricing, contracts, and final deal terms to the founder for approval.

7. Website Updates (Wix)

•      Update and maintain our website on Wix: edit pages, text, images, and links, and keep everything current.

•      Keep the website consistent with the app and our social media in branding, wording, and offers.

•      Add links to the app and to our Instagram, TikTok, and X 
 pages, with clear calls to action for sign-ups and referrals.

•      Add new content as approved, such as testimonials, referral information, and updates about the app.

•      Check that the site works well on mobile, loads quickly, and has no broken links, and apply basic SEO best practices.

•      Make changes with the founder's approval. The Wix account stays under the founder's ownership, with access provided to you.

8. Automated
 Promotion and Re-Engagement (Wix)

•      Set up automated
 campaigns in Wix to promote the new app, such as a launch announcement, a welcome series for new sign-ups, and follow-up reminders.

•      Set up automated
s to our existing contacts to bring engagement back up, such as check-ins, updates, reminders to join the app, and a follow-up series for contacts who have gone quiet.

•      Segment contacts by category (clients, members, leads, partners) and by activity so each message fits the person receiving it.

•      Write the
s in the founder's voice, with clear calls to action and links to join the app.

•      Organize our
 lists from the contact database, following
 rules (permission and an unsubscribe link in every
).

•      Include partner promo codes and offers in
s once they are secured.

•      Submit
s for the founder's approval before they go out.

•      Track opens, clicks, replies, and app sign-ups, and report on what is working and which contacts are re-engaging.

What We Need From You

REQUIRED: Proactive ownership. You do not wait to be told. You bring ideas, flag problems before they happen, and keep the work moving without being nudged. If you need reminders to do your job, this is not the right fit.

REQUIRED: Content strategy and creation experience. You have built content calendars and created content for real brands, and you have a portfolio that proves it. No portfolio, no consideration.

REQUIRED: App-building experience. You have built apps or websites with no-code or low-code tools, and you can share samples.

REQUIRED: Wix experience. You have built or updated websites on Wix and can share examples.

REQUIRED: Caption and script writing in someone else's voice. You write captions and scripts that sound like the creator, not like a template. You can share examples.

REQUIRED: Availability. You must be reachable for calls and meetings during [time window and time zone]. If you cannot commit to this, do not apply.

REQUIRED: This role is your priority. Other client commitments must not interfere with the quality, timeliness, or attention you bring to this role. If you are stretched across multiple clients, this is not the right fit.

•      Attention to detail: you catch inconsistencies before they become problems.

•      Organized and communicative: you tell the founder exactly what you need and when, well in advance. You never go quiet.

•      Open to feedback: you receive direction, implement it the first time, and do not repeat the same mistake.

•      Trend awareness: you know what audio and formats are trending before they peak.

•      Client care: you are warm, professional, and reliable with people, and you keep private information private.

•      Nice to have: real estate, relocation, or sports and coaching marketing experience; Apple App Store and Google Play submission experience; basic photography or videography skills; CRM and
 marketing experience.

Content Guidelines and Privacy

The founder provides photos, videos, and stories. Photos or videos of the founder's children are only posted with approval, and personal details such as a home address or school information are never shared. All work, including the app, designs, content, accounts, and contact data, belongs to [Your Business Name]. All accounts must be created under the founder's ownership, with admin access shared from day one. A confidentiality agreement will be signed.

Compensation and Growth

•      Starting rate: $5.00 per hour, paid for all hours worked

•      Hours: [30] per week, up to [40] during busy periods

•      Incentive-based compensation: paid on top of your hourly rate and tied to results:

o      App completion: a $40 bonus for successful completion of the app, with all review comments cleared, by Friday, November 27, 2026 at close of business

o      Brand deals: incentive pay for each brand deal secured, [amount or percentage, discussed at offer stage]

o      Going viral: incentive pay when a post goes viral, [view threshold, discussed at offer stage]

o      Views: ongoing incentive pay based on views and performance, [structure discussed at offer stage]

•      Raises: regular rate reviews based on performance

What Success Looks Like

•      The app, built from our GroupMe chat and website, successfully completed, with all review comments cleared, by Friday, November 27, 2026 at close of business

•      Our GroupMe members invited and signed up in the app by [date]

•      Our Wix website updated and consistent with the app and our social media by [date]

•      Automated
s promoting the app and re-engaging our existing contacts set up and running in Wix by [date]

•      Pitches sent to moving companies, with promo codes and business partnerships secured

•      3 approved posts published every week at peak hours on Instagram and TikTok, plus daily tweets 
 with each month's content ready for approval by [date]

•      All contacts transferred, cleaned, and backed up by [date]

•      Steady growth in followers, views, engagement, referral inquiries, and app sign-ups

•      Brand deals secured and active

How to Apply

We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered.

Your application must include:

1.     Introduction: who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit right now.

2.     Content strategy experience (REQUIRED): describe a content calendar you built for a brand. What was your process, and what were the results? Share your portfolio.

3.     App experience (REQUIRED): share an app or website you built, the platform you used, and what it did.

4.     Script and caption writing (REQUIRED): share an example of a script or caption you wrote in someone else's voice. What was the hook?

5.     Client experience (REQUIRED): describe how you have handled clients, leads, or customers, and how you kept them happy.

6.     Availability (REQUIRED): confirm you can start [immediately / date] and are available during [time window and time zone].

7.     Other clients: are you currently working with other clients? How do you manage priorities when deadlines conflict?

8.     The brand question: in 2 to 3 sentences, how would you show the story of a single mom of three boys breaking into real estate, and what is the biggest content opportunity for a relocation referral brand right now?

9.     Subject line (REQUIRED): your subject line must read exactly: Content Creator Application. This is your first attention-to-detail test. Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed.

Send applications to 
 or platform link]. A short test task is part of the interview process. It takes about 1 to 2 hours and is [paid / unpaid].

Green Flags

•      Strong content calendar samples with real results

•      A portfolio with real brands and real deliverables

•      Captions and scripts that sound like a human, not a template

•      Clear, specific answers with no vague generalities

•      You reference real estate, relocation, or lifestyle content specifically in your application

•      You catch something in this posting and mention it

•      You go beyond what we asked for

title: HIRING: AI Ads Killer | Cinema Dramas, Songs, Cartoons & UGC
description:
We're hiring an AI video editor who also knows ads. We make Meta ads 
 and Instagram) for a US men's health brand. Our best ads are AI stories: cartoon dramas, song dramas and movie-style scenes. In November, they spent over $100K in a single week.

What the work looks like

• Every day: 1-2 finished ads, 1 to 2.5 minutes each, built from our script and AI clips. You also handle revisions on the previous day's edits.

• Every week: about 8-10 new ads, plus new hooks and new versions of the ads that win.

• Every month: about 35-40 new ads. When a new AI trend takes off on Meta, you help us test it fast.

• AI on top of editing: when a shot, a voice line, a sound effect or a music track is missing, you generate it with AI.

The AI formats you must master

• AI cartoon dramas: a 2D adult-animation look (think The Boondocks), with dialogue between characters.

• AI song and music dramas: a story told through an AI song (Suno or similar), cut on the beat.

• AI movie scenes: photoreal, cinematic dialogue scenes with a film look.

• UGC ads: talking head, AI avatars, b-roll and captions.

In every format, each character keeps the same face and the same voice from the first shot to the last.

Must-haves

• Very strong with AI tools for video, images, voices and music (for example Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Suno, ElevenLabs and lip-sync tools).

• Real experience editing ads for Meta or TikTok. Ads, not only vlogs or wedding videos.

• CapCut or Premiere Pro.

• Clean audio: clear dialogue, every voice at the same level, nothing that hurts the ears.

• Captions that appear exactly when the person speaks, never before.

• Smooth continuity: no jumps in position or distance between shots, and lip sync that matches the voice.

• Good English: you read the script and you can hear when a line sounds off.

• You apply feedback exactly: you change what was asked, and nothing else.

• Comfortable with adult humor and strong language (no nudity).

Nice to have

• Organic content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) with view counts you can show.

• US pop culture: you know the movies, sitcoms and hip-hop our audience watches.

• After Effects or motion design.

How to apply

Start your subject line with SAME VOICE, so we know you read the whole post. Then send:

1.  Your portfolio link: 3 to 5 videos you edited, with at least 2 ads and at least 1 AI video (cartoon, song drama or AI movie scene).

2.  For each video: what you did (AI generation, editing or both) and the result if you know it (spend, views, CTR).

3.  The AI tools you use every week.

4.  Your availability: hours per week and your time zone.

5.  Your monthly rate in USD.

No portfolio link, no reply.

What happens next

1.  We watch every portfolio and shortlist the best editors.

2.  Each shortlisted editor gets a short test: one AI ad built from our script and raw clips, due in 48 hours.

3.  The best test gets the job.

title: AI CRO Specialist
description:
JWEAR STUDIO | AI CRO SPECIALIST



###ROLE & EXPERTISE###



Act as a Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist with 15+ years of experience in Shopify, DTC e-commerce, women's shapewear, lingerie, activewear, and fashion.



You combine the expertise of:



- Senior CRO Strategist

- Shopify Plus Developer

- UX/UI Conversion Designer

- E-commerce Growth Strategist

- Consumer Psychology Specialist

- SEO & Product Page Optimization Expert

- Mobile Commerce Specialist

- Customer Journey Analyst

-
 & Retention Marketing Specialist



Your mission is to identify every major conversion barrier on my website and develop a prioritized, actionable improvement plan.



## 1. BUSINESS INFORMATION



Website: 

Brand: Jwear Studio

Industry: Women's shapewear, lingerie, underwear, and activewear.

Primary market: United States.

Platform: Shopify.

Target audience: Women looking for comfortable, supportive, flattering everyday clothing and shapewear.

Primary objective: Increase conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer trust.



Do not assume you have access to Shopify Analytics, customer behavior, checkout settings, or backend data.



## 2. COMPLETE WEBSITE CRO AUDIT



Visit and analyze my live website.

Inspect the following pages:



- Homepage

- Main navigation and menu

- Collection pages

- Bestselling product pages

- Individual product pages

- Cart and cart drawer

- Checkout, where publicly accessible

- Shipping and return policies

- FAQ and contact pages

- Mobile and desktop layouts



For each page, identify:



1. Conversion barriers.

2. Confusing design elements.

3. Missing trust signals.

4. Unclear messaging.

5. Poor calls to action.

6. Unnecessary friction.

7. Opportunities to increase purchases.



Provide the exact page URL and location of every issue.

Separate verified observations from assumptions and recommendations.



## 3. HOMEPAGE CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION



Evaluate:



- First impression within five seconds.

- Hero banner effectiveness.

- Headline and supporting copy.

- Shop Now buttons.

- Product discovery.

- Bestseller sections.

- Customer reviews.

- Trust badges.

- Shipping information.

- Return guarantees.

- Promotional offers.

- Mobile navigation.

- Visual hierarchy.



Recommend a homepage structure designed to turn paid advertising traffic into customers.



Include suggested copy, section order, and CTA placement.



## 4. PRODUCT PAGE CRO AUDIT



Evaluate every important product page element:



- Product images and videos.

- Product titles.

- Pricing and compare-at pricing.

- Discount presentation.

- Color swatches.

- Size selection.

- Size guides.

- Fit and compression information.

- Product descriptions.

- Benefits versus features.

- Customer reviews.

- Social proof.

- Shipping and delivery information.

- Return policy visibility.

- Add to Cart button.

- Sticky Add to Cart.

- Mobile usability.

- Bundles and quantity discounts.

- Cross-selling and upselling.



Pay special attention to customer objections:



- Will this fit my body?

- Is the sizing accurate?

- Is it comfortable all day?

- Will it roll down?

- Is the fabric breathable?

- How strong is the compression?

- Can I return it?

- When will my order arrive?



Recommend how to address these concerns using clear product information, verified claims, authentic reviews, and effective page design.



## 5. COMPETITOR BENCHMARKING



Research and compare Jwear Studio with:



1. SKIMS

2. Shapellx

3. Popilush

4. FeelinGirl

5. Honeylove



Compare:



- Homepage layout.

- Product page structure.

- Pricing strategy.

- Promotional offers.

- Bundles.

- Product photography.

- Trust signals.

- Customer reviews.

- Shipping policies.

- Returns.

- Mobile shopping experience.

- Conversion-focused features.



Identify which competitor practices Jwear Studio should consider adopting.



Do not recommend copying proprietary designs, brand identities, or unsupported claims.



## 6. WEBSITE SPEED & SHOPIFY APPS



Evaluate publicly measurable website performance.



Focus on:



- Mobile loading speed.

- Largest Contentful Paint.

- Interaction to Next Paint.

- Cumulative Layout Shift.

- Image optimization.

- JavaScript loading.

- Third-party scripts.

- Shopify theme performance.



Identify possible performance issues.



Explain which Shopify apps or scripts might affect performance, but do not claim to know the installed apps without backend access.



Recommend which features should be removed, optimized, or replaced only when supported by evidence.



## 7. CART & CHECKOUT OPTIMIZATION



Analyze the publicly accessible cart and checkout experience.



Review:



- Cart drawer design.

- Checkout progression.

- Shipping cost clarity.

- Discount code experience.

- Payment methods.

- Express checkout options.

- Abandoned cart friction.

- Upsell placement.

- Trust and security messaging.

- Mobile checkout usability.



Identify improvements that can reduce abandonment without introducing unnecessary distractions.



Respect Shopify checkout customization limitations.



## 8. SEO & PRODUCT CONTENT



Review:



- Product titles.

- Meta titles.

- Meta descriptions.

- Collection descriptions.

- Heading structure.

- Internal linking.

- Image alt text.

- Structured data.

- Search intent.

- Duplicate content.



Research relevant keywords for shapewear, bodysuits, underwear, and activewear in the United States.



Recommend SEO improvements that also support conversions.



## 9.
 MARKETING & RETENTION



Create a recommended Klaviyo strategy covering:



- Welcome series.

- Browse abandonment.

- Abandoned cart.

- Abandoned checkout.

- Post-purchase follow-up.

- Product education.

- Cross-selling.

- Win-back campaigns.

- Customer segmentation.



For each flow, recommend timing, message purpose, audience, and performance metrics.



Do not invent existing flow performance.



## 10. CRO PRIORITY SCORING



Score each identified issue using:



- Impact: 1–10

- Confidence: 1–10

- Implementation effort: 1–10



Calculate a priority score using:



Priority = Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort



Clearly explain that these are estimated prioritization scores, not measured revenue effects.



Categorize recommendations into:



P0: Critical conversion barriers.



P1: High-impact quick wins.



P2: Important improvements.



P3: Longer-term experiments.



## 11. REVENUE OPPORTUNITY ANALYSIS



Create a scenario analysis using these example conversion rates:



- 1.0%

- 1.5%

- 2.0%

- 2.5%

- 3.0%

- 4.0%



Show projected orders and revenue for 10,000 monthly sessions.



Use an illustrative average order value of $60 unless actual data is provided.



Explain that these are mathematical scenarios, not guaranteed outcomes or industry benchmarks.



## 12. 30-DAY IMPLEMENTATION PLAN



Develop a practical implementation roadmap.



Week 1: Audit, analytics validation, and critical fixes.



Week 2: Homepage and product page improvements.



Week 3: Cart, checkout, trust, and mobile optimization.



Week 4: Testing, measurement, and iteration.



For each task provide:



- Exact change required.

- Page or Shopify section.

- Expected customer benefit.

- Priority.

- Responsible specialist.

- Estimated implementation time.

- KPI to measure success.



## 13. FINAL DELIVERABLES



Provide the following:



1. Executive CRO audit.

2. Overall CRO score out of 100, clearly labeled as a heuristic assessment.

3. Top 20 conversion barriers.

4. Top 10 quick wins.

5. Competitor comparison.

6. Recommended homepage layout.

7. Recommended product page layout.

8. Mobile optimization checklist.

9. Shopify speed improvement plan.

10. Cart and checkout improvement plan.

11.
 retention strategy.

12. Prioritized 30-day CRO roadmap.

13. Developer-ready implementation instructions.

14. A/B testing hypotheses and success metrics.



## IMPORTANT RULES



Be critical, specific, and evidence-based.



Do not give generic advice.



Do not invent website issues, competitor features, analytics data, or performance scores.



If you cannot access a page, clearly state that limitation.



Use screenshots or precise page references when possible.



Distinguish verified findings from recommendations.



Do not modify the live Shopify store without my explicit approval.



Focus on measurable improvements to conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer experience.



Start by auditing 
 and provide the 10 most important findings first.



Requirements to apply:

2. Portfolio

3. Your findings

 containing the requirements with the subject line: OLJ | AI CRO Specialist - [Your Full Name]

About Us

Position Overview

Your responsibility is to maintain strong communication with the seller, keep the deal moving forward, resolve issues, and renegotiate terms when necessary to ensure the transaction remains viable.

Qualifications



Proven sales, negotiation, account management, or relationship-management experience



Strong verbal and written communication skills



Confident handling difficult conversations and negotiating contract terms



Ability to build trust while remaining firm and solution-oriented



Highly organized and capable of managing multiple active files at the same time



Strong follow-up habits and attention to detail



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment



Self-motivated, accountable, and results-oriented



Real estate experience is preferred but not required



Experience in real estate, solar, insurance, automotive sales, or another high-activity sales environment is a plus



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is competitive, organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent. You should be able to connect with sellers, uncover the real cause of an issue, and confidently guide the conversation toward a solution.



You must be comfortable taking ownership of your files and being held accountable for performance.



Why Join Solution Based Homebuyers?



High earning potential tied directly to deal performance



Base compensation plus commission



Clear opportunities for advancement within a growing real estate company



Hands-on training and support



Collaborative, in-office team environment



Fast-paced culture focused on execution, accountability, and results



We are hiring immediately.

Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:



Miami, FL 33133 (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote
