Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)



Compensation: Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 100,000+ per month, depending on individual sales performance. This role offers a competitive compensation structure with commissions and performance incentives that reward high achievers.



Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.



Leave: One week paid leave per year.



About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

We’re open to candidates with less experience if you show initiative, strong communication skills, and the right mindset.



Tools You’ll Use

- Direct mentorship from leadership

- Long-term career growth in a scaling business

- Exposure to end-to-end Australian STR operations



A role where initiative, ownership, and ideas are genuinely valued

title: Senior Construction Scheduler & Project Controls Lead (Wunderbuild Expert)
description:
READ FIRST: WUNDERBUILD EXPERTS ONLY. NO EXCEPTIONS.



You must be an expert Wunderbuild user today, with project schedules you personally built and ran in it. Experience with MS Project, Primavera, Procore, Buildertrend or any other software does NOT qualify. If you have not personally built schedules in Wunderbuild, do not apply.



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | US Residential Remodeling

Compensation: $9–$15 USD/hour depending on experience; higher for exceptional candidates





ROLE OVERVIEW

Craftsman Collective is a design-build remodeling company in Austin, Texas, specializing in midcentury modern homes. We self-perform much of our work with our own crew, alongside trusted subcontractors, and run several projects at once.



We are moving our project management to Wunderbuild and need an expert to lead that transition. You will own our project schedules, company-wide schedule, material quotes, purchase orders and material tracking in Wunderbuild. You will set the system up the right way and train our team to use it. We are not training anyone on Wunderbuild: you must be ready to contribute on day one and teach the rest of us.



Your job is to keep crews, subcontractors and materials moving together, so our Project Manager can make decisions instead of doing administration. You propose dates, lock them in, and hold people to them. Given a scope and a trade list, you build a draft schedule without waiting to be asked.



This role is open to a senior project controls lead or a highly experienced project coordinator.





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Scheduling

• Build and maintain logic-linked schedules for every project in Wunderbuild: tasks, dependencies, inspections and milestones.

• Draft new project schedules and propose start dates for Project Manager approval.

• Track daily progress against the schedule using video reports, written site reports and timesheets.

• Update schedules as conditions change, and flag delays and critical-path risks the day you see them.

• Maintain a company-wide schedule showing where our crew and subcontractors are each week, and spot conflicts.

• Schedule and confirm subcontractors, and set up Wunderbuild's automated reminders and confirmations.



Material Quotes, Purchase Orders & Tracking

• Build procurement milestones into every schedule: selections due, quotes, approvals, order dates, lead times and delivery dates.

• Get material quotes from suppliers and coordinate pricing to finalize purchase orders. (Our estimator handles subcontract bidding.)

• Submit material selections and pricing to the Project Manager for approval before any order is placed. We quote builder-grade materials, so any upgrade must be priced and approved first. No approval, no order.

• Create and track purchase orders from quote through delivery.

• Maintain a material tracking log for each project: what is quoted, approved, ordered, shipped and delivered, and what is still outstanding.

• Confirm delivery dates with suppliers and keep them matched to the schedule.

• Flag long-lead items and late orders before they hold up work.

• Help build and enforce our standard process for material quotes, approvals, purchase orders and ordering.



Wunderbuild Transition & Training

• Lead our move to Wunderbuild: set up project templates, task libraries, users, permissions, notifications and automations.

• Move our active projects into Wunderbuild and keep the data clean and consistent.

• Train our Project Manager, superintendent, crew leads and office staff, and write simple how-to guides.

• Serve as our in-house Wunderbuild expert and find ways to automate more of our work.



Meetings & Reporting

• Host weekly lookahead meetings covering 3-week, 6-week and 12-week horizons, and record decisions and owners.

• Send a weekly status summary of schedule risks, procurement risks, open decisions and follow-ups.

• Prepare schedule updates and proposed start dates for the Project Manager.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

You own the schedule and material procurement process, not the scope or the budget. Estimating, subcontract bidding and change orders are handled by our estimator. The Project Manager approves schedule baselines, purchases, pricing and scope changes, and the superintendent runs the field. No material order is placed without Project Manager approval. This is not a client-facing role: all communication with homeowners goes through the Project Manager.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Expert Wunderbuild user, with schedules you personally built and ran in it (non-negotiable)

• Able to set up Wunderbuild for a company and train others to use it

• 5+ years in construction scheduling, project coordination or project controls

• Proven ability to build logic-linked schedules: dependencies, lags, critical path and lookaheads

• Experience getting supplier quotes, creating and tracking purchase orders, and tracking material deliveries against a schedule

• Strong understanding of residential building sequence: demolition, framing, rough-ins, inspections, drywall, cabinetry and finishes

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident running video meetings and training sessions

• Proactive and firm: you push for dates, follow up without being asked, and escalate early

• Reliable high-speed internet with backup power



Nice to have: Any exposure to US residential construction (codes, inspections, trade terms), and experience leading a scheduling or project coordination team.





WORKING ARRANGEMENT

• Full-time, 40 hours/week, remote

• Must be able to work US Central Time hours

• Hours logged against the individual projects you support from personal computer

• Reports to the Project Manager





HOW TO APPLY



Apply with your resume and short answers to these questions:

1. Which companies have you used Wunderbuild for, and for how long?

2. About how many project schedules have you built in Wunderbuild, and what types of projects were they?

3. Have you set up Wunderbuild for a company or trained others to use it? Briefly describe what you did.

4. Walk us through how you take a material order from supplier quote to approval, purchase order and delivery.

5. What is your expected hourly rate?

title: Account Manager (Clipping Campaigns)
description:
About Elnez

Elnez is a performance-based UGC and content distribution platform. We turn long-form content into high-impact short-form clips and distribute them across TikTok, Reels, Shorts and X to reach millions of viewers and drive measurable results for creators and brands.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Account Manager to oversee the execution of clipping campaigns and manage relationships with both clients and participating clippers.



This role sits at the center of campaign operations, requiring someone who can take a campaign from client onboarding through execution and delivery. You will work closely with clients to understand their objectives, translate campaign requirements into actionable briefs, and ensure campaigns are adequately staffed with qualified and active clippers.



A key part of the position involves sourcing and recruiting clippers, building relationships within clipping communities, and maintaining the level of participation needed to keep campaigns running effectively. You will also be responsible for monitoring campaign activity, tracking performance, resolving operational challenges, and keeping clients informed of progress.



The ideal candidate understands the clipping ecosystem, is comfortable with outbound recruitment and relationship management, and can take ownership of multiple campaigns while ensuring that both client expectations and campaign objectives are met.



Key Responsibilities

Manage client accounts and oversee the full lifecycle of clipping campaigns, from onboarding and campaign setup to execution, optimization, and completion.



Work with clients to understand campaign objectives, content requirements, budgets, and expected outcomes, translating these into clear campaign briefs and execution plans.



Source, recruit, and onboard clippers through direct outreach, social media, 
 communities, referrals, and other relevant channels to build a reliable network of campaign participants.



Coordinate campaign launches, communicate briefs and requirements to participating clippers, and ensure they have the necessary information and resources to execute campaigns effectively.



Maintain active relationships with clippers, facilitate communication, address questions and participation issues, and encourage consistent campaign involvement.



Monitor campaign activity, including clip submissions, publishing frequency, views, engagement, and other relevant performance metrics, ensuring campaigns remain on track.



Identify gaps in campaign participation or performance and take appropriate action, whether through additional clipper recruitment, improved communication, or adjustments to campaign execution.



Keep clients informed through regular updates and performance reports, communicating campaign progress, results, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.



Coordinate with internal teams responsible for content review, submission verification, and reward processing to ensure smooth campaign delivery.



Maintain accurate records of campaign activity, clipper participation, client requirements, and performance results.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign outcomes, strengthen client relationships, and encourage repeat business.

Requirements



2+ years of experience in account management, campaign management, creator marketing, influencer marketing, or a related field.



Understanding of clipping campaigns, creator distribution, and social media content ecosystems.

Experience with creator, influencer, or clipper recruitment, including prospecting and outbound outreach.



Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and other short-form content distribution platforms.

Experience managing client relationships and coordinating campaign execution.



Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and creator communities.



Ability to interpret campaign performance data and use insights to improve execution.



Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Familiarity with 
, spreadsheets, project management tools, and campaign tracking platforms.



Compensation

1. Base Compensation: Initial base compensation: $200/month.

After 90 days, base compensation increases to up to $600/month, depending on the Net Revenue Retention (NRR) performance of assigned client campaigns.



2. Performance-Based Compensation

In addition to the monthly base compensation, Account Managers earn a percentage of the campaign budget actually spent on clipper payouts each month.



This is the primary earning component of the role and has no fixed earnings cap.

5% commission: On qualifying campaign budgets spent and paid out to clippers.

5% commission: Applies to campaign budgets exceeding $30,000, subject to the company's commission calculation policy.

Performance commissions are paid after the corresponding campaign budget has been fully spent.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means being able to independently manage assigned client accounts, ensure campaigns are properly staffed with active clippers, maintain consistent campaign execution, and deliver measurable results.



You should be capable of building the clipper network required to support campaigns, keeping participants engaged, identifying and resolving execution challenges, and maintaining client confidence through effective communication and reliable delivery.



Please apply only if you have prior experience managing campaigns and are comfortable with the compensation structure outlined above.

title: online marketing and first-line support for a growing set of apps and web tools
description:
I'm an independent developer in the Netherlands. I build and run a small family of apps and online tools, and I'm looking for one reliable VA to help people find them, for the long term.



What you'll promote



You start with two products that are launching now:



- A Mac app that shows people where their disk space goes and what a cleanup really frees. It launches on 1 December, with a Black Friday offer this week.

- An online short link service with link-in-bio pages and QR codes, for creators and businesses who share links on social media. 



These two come first, are ready to go and have Black Friday deals ready. That's why I need someone who can start as soon as possible, ideally this week.



After that, the job grows. I have more online tools to promote, for example a tool for musicians that finds piano and guitar chords and a few small web tools, with more to come. You'll get to know each one before you promote it.



What you'll do



- Community marketing: find conversations on Reddit, forums, LinkedIn and other platforms where people have the problem one of our products solves, and answer them genuinely helpfully, mentioning the product only when it really fits.

- Social media: write and schedule posts (LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, etc) from material I provide.

- Research and outreach: find communities, blogs, newsletters and creators that fit each product, check their rules, write personal pitch
s, and follow up.

- Directory listings: submit the products to software and app directories.

- First-line support: answer simple customer
s using our help pages, and pass anything technical, billing-related or tricky to me. There's very little of this at first; it grows with the products.



How we work



- Everything happens in our task system. Each task has clear written instructions. You log your work, links and time there, so there are no separate reports to write.

- Honesty is non-negotiable. You always disclose that you work with the developer. You never write fake reviews, never create fake accounts to praise our products, and never manipulate votes or ratings.

- You use your own logins and a work
 address I provide.

- Flexible hours, any time zone. 3 to 5 hours a day, whenever suits you. A regular daily rhythm helps, so customers and I know when to expect replies.



You are



- Fluent in written English, with a friendly, clear and natural writing style.

- Comfortable on Reddit, LinkedIn, 
 and the like. An established Reddit account is a plus, but not required: you're welcome to create a new account for this work.

- Careful with details and good at following written guidelines.

- Patient and polite with customers.

- Curious about technology. Experience with a Mac is a plus.



Pay and start



Start: as soon as possible, ideally this week. Long-term work, with more hours as more products are added. Weekly payments via EasyPay (https://www.onlinejobs.ph/easypay)



How to apply



I read every application myself, so I want to see that you read this whole post. Your application must contain:



1. A subject line or first line in this exact form: "VA application: [your first name], [your time zone]".

2. Three short answers in your own words:

   - Which two products will you work on first, and why do they come first?

   - Name the three things this post says you will never do.

   - Where do you log your work, and why does that mean you don't write reports?

3. A sample reply (under 100 words) to this question, written as you would on Reddit: "My Mac says 'System Data' is using 120 GB. What is it and can I delete it?" Don't mention any app.

4. Links to your LinkedIn profile, and to your Reddit profile if you have one.

5. Your available hours and your time zone.



Applications that skip any of these points won't be considered.



Next steps



- Shortlisted applicants are invited for a video interview (about 20 minutes).

- After that, a short paid trial task (about 2 hours).

- Then I choose, and we start right away.



Hope to hear from you soon!



Cheers,



Bjørn

title: PCB Design Engineer

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field

• Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) prior to fab release

• Apply EMI best practices throughout PCB layout including ground plane strategy, decoupling, and trace routing to minimize radiated and conducted emissions

• Ability to read and produce professional-quality schematics, PCB fabrication packages, and wiring documentation

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English



Preferred Qualifications:

This position is fully remote with flexible work times. Occasional meetings in the Central Time Zone will be required.



Pay rate will be based on education, skills, and experience.

Hussar Holdings Co. is a U.S.-based holding company led by Kirk Koskiniemi, an entrepreneur with 15+ years of business ownership. Our family of companies includes a commercial roofing contractor, real estate and property management entities, and other growing businesses. Our leadership has worked with Filipino professionals for years and values their skill, loyalty, and professionalism.

Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Your shift must overlap with U.S. Pacific Time. Choose one:

- 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific (12:00 AM – 8:00 AM PH time)

PH times shown are for November–March. From March–November, PH times are one hour earlier due to U.S. daylight saving time.



PAY

$5–$6 USD per hour based on experience (approx. $865–$1,040 USD/month) + 13th Month Pay



WHAT YOU'LL DO

WHAT YOU BRING

- Comfortable with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Outlook & OneDrive

- Clear written and spoken English; comfortable on video calls with camera on

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace



BIG PLUSES

- CPA or CPA board exam candidate

- Backup power and internet



HOW TO APPLY (INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED): Due 11/30/2026

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Application and video review → Short QuickBooks skills test → Video interview with our Corporate Controller → Offer

This is a fully remote position.



We are a company in the window cleaning and home services industry, and we are looking for a highly dependable, confident, and professional Virtual Assistant to handle outbound calling and estimate booking on behalf of our business.



This is a phone-first role. Your primary responsibility is to call potential residential and commercial customers, introduce our services, build genuine interest, and successfully schedule estimate appointments. If you are someone who thrives on conversations, enjoys connecting with people, and takes pride in turning a cold call into a booked appointment, we want to hear from you.





ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be making outbound calls to prospects and representing our business in a friendly, professional, and persuasive manner. This is not a passive role. We are looking for someone who can carry a conversation naturally, handle objections confidently, and consistently deliver results in the form of booked estimates.



The schedule follows Central Daytime hours in the United States.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make outbound calls to residential and commercial prospects on a daily basis

- Introduce the company and its window cleaning services in a clear, engaging, and professional manner

- Guide conversations confidently toward scheduling estimate appointments

- Book estimate appointments according to customer availability

- Handle objections and common questions from potential customers in a calm and professional way

- Provide regular updates on calling activity, results, and any notable customer feedback

QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent spoken English with a clear, natural-sounding voice and minimal accent that does not interfere with customer understanding

- Strong phone presence with confident, professional, and personable communication skills

- Proven ability to book appointments through outbound calling, not simply making calls or reading a script

- Previous experience in outbound calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting is required

- Experience booking appointments for home services, cleaning companies, or similar local service businesses is a strong advantage

- Familiarity with CRM systems and call-tracking tools is preferred

- Experience handling objections and speaking with US-based customers is a significant plus

- Excellent attendance and punctuality with a strong track record of dependability and consistency

- Ability to work independently, manage daily calling targets, and follow up without constant oversight

- Open to feedback and committed to improving performance over time

- Must have a quiet, professional, distraction-free workspace

- Must have a quality noise-canceling headset with a clear microphone (this is non-negotiable)

- Must have a stable, reliable internet connection with a backup option available in case of outages





IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are confident and comfortable initiating conversations with people you have never spoken with before. You are friendly, persuasive, and customer-focused. You show up consistently, take ownership of your results, and understand that the goal is booked qualified estimates, not simply a high call count. You are organized, detail-oriented, and responsive, and you do not need to be micromanaged to stay on track.





HOW TO APPLY

We look forward to hearing from you.

Requirements

Why Join

title: Experienced eBay Listing Specialist - Used OEM Auto Parts | PART-TIME, LONG-TERM
description:
About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based business specializing in used OEM automotive parts sold on eBay.

We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented eBay Listing Specialist to join our team long-term.

We have an established inventory system, prepared listing information, training videos, and detailed SOPs to help you succeed.



We are not looking for someone learning eBay from scratch. We want someone who already understands eBay Seller Hub, can follow instructions accurately, and takes pride in their work.



Important: This is an eBay-only position. We do not cross-list products to other marketplaces. No cross-listing software or applications are required. All listing work is performed directly through eBay Seller Hub.



What You'll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be creating accurate eBay listings using our prepared inventory information.



WE PROVIDE:



Listing titles that are approximately 85% complete.



Product photographs and SKU numbers.



Vehicle year, make, model, and available part information.



Color and condition details.



Pricing information.



Links to example listings for reference.



Description and condition-note templates using Text Blaze.



A prepared master inventory spreadsheet.



YOUR RESONSIBILITIES:



Create eBay listing drafts directly in eBay Seller Hub.

Finalize titles following our formatting standards.

Complete item specifics and relevant compatibility fields using our supplied information and SOPs.

Upload and organize photographs correctly.

Enter accurate SKUs, prices, and condition information.

Flag missing details, inconsistencies, or uncertain fitment instead of guessing.

Track listing progress and complete assigned batches on schedule.

Review your work for accuracy before submitting it.

Our workflow is designed to be efficient. Once fully trained, our target is approximately 5 minutes per standard listing, while maintaining high accuracy.



WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE : 



Our inventory operates on a monthly sourcing and processing cycle.



We currently prepare approximately 120–330 parts per month, depending on sourcing volume.



The primary inventory handoff normally happens around the Wednesday following the first Saturday of each month.



Most listing work is concentrated in the following days, with deadlines agreed upon based on batch size.



This is a part-time, flexible position with variable hours. Some weeks may have little or no work.



We expect approximately 10–30 productive listing hours per month at our target pace, with additional hours possible for training, corrections, and business growth.



We are seeking someone comfortable with this arrangement who can reliably accommodate our monthly batches.





MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS:



At least 1 year of hands-on eBay listing experience.

Strong familiarity with eBay Seller Hub and creating listings directly on eBay.

Experience listing physical products, preferably used inventory.

Excellent attention to detail.

Good written English and communication skills.

Ability to follow detailed SOPs and instructions.

Comfortable working with Google Sheets.

Desktop PC required.

Reliable internet connection.

Ability to meet agreed deadlines and communicate proactively.



Preferred:

Experience listing used automotive or OEM parts.

Knowledge of vehicle compatibility, part numbers, and variations.

Multiple monitors for efficient multitasking.

Previous experience using Text Blaze or similar productivity tools.

Cross-listing experience or software is not required. We sell exclusively through eBay.

Training & Onboarding



We provide:



5 training videos.



4 detailed PDF SOPs.



Live listing demonstrations.



Guided practice with feedback.



A structured mock-listing assessment.



Our onboarding process includes:



Watching us complete 5 listings.



Completing 10 listings with supervision.



Completing 10 listings independently for review.



Completing a batch of 100 mock listings on a secondary account, with quality-control checkpoints.



All approved training and practice work is paid.



We value accuracy, consistency, communication, and the ability to learn from feedback.



Compensation



Starting pay is $5.25 USD per hour, including approved training and listing work.



Performance bonuses may be offered for consistently accurate work, reliability, and strong performance.



We are looking for a long-term team member, with the potential for additional responsibilities and hours as our business grows.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the phrase "OEM Accuracy" so we know you have read the job description.



Answer the following questions:



How many years of experience do you have creating listings directly through eBay Seller Hub? What types of products have you listed?



Have you previously listed used automotive parts? If yes, tell us about your experience with fitment, part numbers, or vehicle compatibility.



Please share 2–3 examples of eBay listings you personally created. Links or screenshots are acceptable.



Do you have a desktop PC? How many monitors do you use? If comfortable, please include a photo of your workstation showing an OK hand sign (👌). Your face does not need to be visible.



Are you comfortable working on recurring monthly batches, with variable hours and agreed deadlines?



What is your expected hourly rate in USD, and when are you available to start?



Practical Demonstration: Please provide a screen recording of yourself creating a mock used automotive part listing directly in eBay Seller Hub. You may choose any automotive part you are familiar with. Photographs are not required. Demonstrate how you would complete the title, item specifics, condition, compatibility (if applicable), and other relevant listing fields. Attempt the listing to the best of your ability, even if you do not have previous automotive parts experience.



Important: This is a demonstration only. Do not publish the mock listing or expose private account information. Please share a link to your screen recording.



Please answer the questions in your own words. We understand that AI tools can be useful, but we prefer genuine, personal responses so we can get to know your actual experience and communication style.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief video interview.



We value reliability, honesty, attention to detail, and people who take ownership of their work.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Director of Finance & People Operations
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a family-run residential property management company in Boston, Massachusetts. Our family has been in Boston real estate since 1952. We manage 1,000+ condo units, 500+ rental units, and 60+ condominium associations, with 50+ full-time team members across the US and the Philippines. Our clients rate us 4.9 stars on Google.



We're growing, and we're looking for a senior leader to run both our Finance and HR teams.



The Role



You'll report directly to our COO and lead two managers, our Controller and our HR Manager. You'll own the company's financial discipline and its people systems, and make sure both teams deliver accurate, on-time work without needing day-to-day supervision from leadership.



This is NOT a bookkeeping or HR assistant role. It's a manager-of-managers position for someone who has already led finance and HR teams and can turn numbers and people data into clear decisions.



What You'll Do



Finance



Lead the Controller on month-end close, account reconciliations, AR/AP, payroll accounting, and financial reporting

Keep company books (QuickBooks Online) and client/property books (Buildium) clearly separated

Own budgeting, forecasting, a weekly 13-week cash forecast, and monthly variance reviews

Deliver a monthly management report on revenue, margin, expenses, labor, cash, receivables, and risks

Set and enforce internal controls, approval limits, and reconciliation standards

Improve finance dashboards, data quality, and automation

HR & People Operations



Lead the HR Manager and hold the HR team accountable for recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, retention, and offboarding

Build a workforce plan covering the roles we need, hiring priorities, and compensation cost

Make sure hiring uses role scorecards, structured interviews, and clear pipeline reporting

Track and improve time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, turnover, and review completion

Build compensation ranges, promotion criteria, and career paths

Leadership



Serve as the COO's right hand for finance and HR operations

Turn financial and people data into a short action list with owners and deadlines

Spot problems early and come with a recommendation, not just the problem

Protect confidential employee, payroll, client, and financial information

Requirements



Several years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including month-end close, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls

Proven experience managing managers (not just individual staff)

Working knowledge of HR operations: recruitment, performance management, payroll and benefits coordination, and employee relations

Experience with US-based companies and US accounting standards

Experience in property management, real estate, or a multi-entity business is a big plus

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable holding managers accountable, respectfully and directly

Available to work US Eastern Time business hours

Reliable internet connection, a laptop/PC, and a working headset and camera

Preferred



CPA, CMA, MBA, or HR certification

Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Buildium, BambooHR, Google Workspace, Asana, or Slack

Experience improving close speed, cash forecasting, collections, or employee retention, with numbers to show for it

What We Offer



$[X,XXX] – $[X,XXX] USD per month

[Benefits: TBD, e.g. paid time off, HMO allowance, paid holidays]

Long-term, stable full-time role with a well-established US company

A true leadership seat reporting directly to the COO

Work from home

How to Apply

Your updated resume to

title: Remote Director of Maintenance
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our maintenance operation must deliver fast, reliable service while controlling quality, labor, vendor capacity, billing, and client expectations.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Director is the senior functional leader responsible for maintenance performance across Green Ocean Property Management and Pro Services Boston. Reporting to the COO, this person owns service levels, field-team people management, project and coordination workflows, vendor capacity, department financial performance, and the systems required to deliver consistent work.

This is not primarily a dispatcher, technician, or individual project-manager role. The Director leads the maintenance function through clear scorecards, documented processes, direct management of the field team, and defined responsibilities for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, and Maintenance Coordination Team. The right person will make maintenance predictable, profitable, and less dependent on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Core Outcomes

Reliable service response: Emergency and routine requests are acknowledged, scheduled, and completed against approved service levels.

Controlled backlog: Every open item has a clear owner, status, next action, and escalation path; aged work is reduced and kept within approved limits.

Profitable maintenance delivery: Labor, vendor cost, billing completeness, project margin, and rework are measured and actively managed.

Consistent field quality: Inspections, workmanship standards, documentation, callbacks, and quality reviews are built into the operating process.

Clear people accountability: Field staff receive direct expectations, coaching, performance follow-up, and capacity planning from the Maintenance Director.

Scalable systems: Intake, coordination, project delivery, field execution, vendor management, and owner/property-manager handoffs are documented and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

Maintenance Operations Leadership

Own the maintenance operating system from request intake through scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing handoff, and closeout.

Set emergency and routine service levels, escalation rules, quality standards, and communication expectations.

Run weekly maintenance operating reviews covering backlog, aging, scheduled work, emergencies, callbacks, staffing, vendor capacity, and financial performance.

Ensure the Maintenance Coordination Team maintains accurate work-order status, scheduling, resident communication, vendor communication, and after-hours handoffs.

Hold the Project Manager / Estimator accountable for scopes, estimates, schedules, project delivery, change control, documentation, and project margins.

Use the Field Operations Specialist for inspections, technical troubleshooting, difficult jobs, field recommendations, and workmanship checks without assigning people-management duties to that role.

Maintain complete, decision-ready records in PropertyMeld, Buildium, approved trackers, and related source systems.

Field Team and People Leadership

Directly manage field staff, including performance expectations, schedules, coaching, attendance, discipline, development, and staffing decisions.

Define required skills, productivity expectations, quality standards, safety practices, and documentation requirements for each field role.

Build labor and vendor capacity plans that match seasonal demand, portfolio growth, emergency coverage, and project commitments.

Identify performance issues early, document expectations, and complete timely follow-up rather than allowing unresolved problems to move upward to the COO.

Create practical onboarding and training plans for field staff, coordinators, estimators, and vendors.

Maintain a span of control that is workable at current headcount and recommend another frontline leadership seat only when workload and staffing data justify it.

Financial and Vendor Leadership

Own the maintenance budget, labor plan, vendor plan, gross-margin review, billing completeness, and material cost controls.

Ensure all billable labor, materials, vendor costs, estimates, approvals, and change orders are documented and handed to Finance on time.

Review vendor performance, pricing, availability, insurance requirements, service quality, and replacement risk.

Partner with Finance to reconcile operational activity with billing, payroll, vendor bills, receivables, and department reporting.

Identify unprofitable work types, repeated callbacks, underbilling, capacity gaps, and process failures, then bring a corrective recommendation to the COO.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the COO's accountable leader for maintenance outcomes and risks.

Coordinate with Property Operations, Leasing, Customer Success, On Ramp, Finance, and Systems/Data on handoffs that cross departments.

Convert maintenance data into a short executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.

Build and maintain maintenance playbooks for routine work, emergencies, projects, inspections, vendor use, resident communication, and billing handoff.

Identify risks early and bring a recommendation, not only a problem, to the COO and CEO.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Maintenance Director is expected to improve routine maintenance processes, manage staff and vendors, enforce approved controls and deadlines, assign work, resolve routine escalations, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on material unbudgeted commitments, senior hires or terminations, major vendor changes, significant pricing or policy changes, legal or safety matters, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO. The Director owns maintenance management and results. The role should not depend on personally performing routine field work or redoing coordinator and project-manager tasks.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Emergency and routine service requests meet approved acknowledgment, scheduling, and completion standards.

Aged work orders remain within approved limits, and every material exception has an owner, next action, and date.

Scheduled work, field productivity, project delivery, and vendor capacity are reported weekly.

Billing documentation, labor, material, estimate, approval, and change-order records are complete and timely.

Callbacks, rework, quality defects, safety issues, and repeated failures are measured and reduced against baseline.

Field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

First 90 Days

First 30 Days - Diagnose and Establish Control

Review the maintenance organization, open roles, direct-report capabilities, workload, current vendors, and existing scorecards.

Assess PropertyMeld data, backlog, aging, emergencies, callbacks, projects, estimates, billing handoffs, margin reporting, and field capacity.

Confirm decision rights for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, Maintenance Coordination Team, and field staff.

Identify material client, safety, staffing, vendor, financial, and key-person risks.

Agree with the COO on the final scorecard, reporting cadence, approval limits, and escalation rules.

Days 31-60 - Install the Operating Cadence

Launch one weekly maintenance operating review and one monthly financial and capacity review.

Publish service levels, backlog definitions, escalation rules, quality checks, and communication standards.

Implement direct-report scorecards and regular one-on-ones.

Create the field and vendor capacity plan and assign owners to the highest-risk gaps.

Document the required workflow from intake through billing handoff and closeout.

Days 61-90 - Demonstrate Independent Execution

Run a complete maintenance operating cycle without relying on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Show measurable movement in aged backlog, scheduling reliability, quality, billing completeness, and team accountability.

Present a 12-month maintenance improvement plan ranked by business impact, risk, effort, cost, and owner.

Demonstrate that field staff and supporting roles operate against clear metrics and decision rights.

Required Qualifications

Significant progressive experience leading maintenance, facilities, construction service, field operations, or a comparable multi-site service function.

Proven people-management experience, including performance expectations, coaching, discipline, hiring, staffing, and direct accountability for a field team.

Working knowledge of work-order operations, emergency response, estimating, project delivery, vendor management, quality control, and safety practices.

Experience owning a department budget, labor capacity, vendor cost, billing completeness, and operating metrics.

Ability to distinguish technical expertise from people leadership and assign each responsibility to the correct role.

Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, documentation, and comfort holding staff, vendors, and peers accountable.

Experience with property-management, maintenance-management, scheduling, reporting, and collaboration systems.

Ability to lead a distributed team across field and remote functions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential property management, condominium/HOA management, multifamily operations, or an in-house maintenance business.

Experience with PropertyMeld, Buildium, QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.

Experience improving response time, backlog aging, gross margin, billing completeness, vendor capacity, callbacks, or field productivity with measurable results.

Relevant trade, construction-management, facilities, project-management, or safety qualification.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.

Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.

Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.

Paid holidays, subject to the company holiday calendar.

Leadership Profile

Leads through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision.

Creates practical controls without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Uses source data before drawing conclusions and distinguishes urgent work from high-value work.

Solves recurring problems through ownership, process, and systems.

Coaches people while holding a firm performance standard.

Communicates bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.



Internal Hiring Note

Because this role directly manages field staff and leads several specialized functions, the hiring process should test people leadership, maintenance operations, financial judgment, vendor management, and the ability to build systems without personally taking over every task. Technical maintenance knowledge without proven people accountability is not sufficient.

Role Performance Metrics

Primary scorecard. Targets are recommended starting points and should be confirmed against the current baseline during the first 30 days.

#

Metric

Target

Measurement source

1

Emergency response control

100% of emergency requests acknowledged within the approved emergency SLA; every missed SLA has a documented cause and corrective action.

PropertyMeld emergency reports and escalation log.

2

Aged backlog control

100% of work older than the approved aging threshold has an owner, next action, and due date; aged backlog improves against the confirmed baseline.

PropertyMeld backlog and aging reports.

3

Schedule reliability

At least 90% of scheduled work is completed by the promised date, excluding documented access, approval, or scope-change delays.

PropertyMeld schedule, completion records, and exception reasons.

4

Billing and margin control

100% of billable labor, materials, vendor costs, approvals, and change orders are documented and submitted on time; department margin is reviewed monthly.

PropertyMeld, time records, vendor bills, Buildium, and finance reporting.

5

Quality and team accountability

Callbacks and rework remain within the approved target; 100% of required scorecards, one-on-ones, reviews, and documented performance follow-ups are completed on time.

Quality reviews, callback log, manager scorecards, and HR records.



Ownership standard: The Director owns these results through field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team. Results should reflect independent team performance rather than work the Director personally completed or redid.

title: Pricing Analyst (Government Contracts)
description:
THE ROLE

The Pricing Analyst maximizes company profitability by building competitive, compliant pricing based on data analysis, market trends, and service delivery costs. You'll work with Procurement, Operations, Finance, and Leadership to make sure every price is accurate, defensible, and backed by data.



This role is built for someone who already knows security or service-industry pricing in a government contracting environment and needs little to no training.



Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time (US)

Location: Fully remote



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Receive and interpret requests for quotations, solicitations, contracts, and other formats, and translate them into pricing models

- Build and manage pricing requests, proposals, discounts, and commercial offers

- Develop labor-based pricing, including wage rates, fringe benefits, burdens, overhead, and profit

- Provide pricing support to Procurement and Business Development, and communicate rate structures clearly and confidently to stakeholders

- Troubleshoot pricing discrepancies using rate rules and logical analysis

- Update and maintain pricing and cost data and assumptions, including market research and competitor comparisons

- Track pricing performance and identify opportunities to improve margins and win rates

- Coordinate with other departments to validate pricing information

- Make sure pricing practices follow company policy, business guidelines, and contract requirements

- Handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion



WHAT YOU BRING



Required: Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of directly related experience in place of a degree)

- 3+ years of pricing, costing, or financial analysis experience

- Experience in the security industry or a service-based industry (e.g., security, janitorial, facilities, staffing, or other labor-driven services)

- Government contracting (GovCon) pricing experience, including pricing submitted on federal RFQs/RFPs



Required: GovCon Pricing Skills

- Building fully burdened hourly bill rates from the ground up: base wage, fringe, health & welfare, payroll taxes (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), workers' compensation, insurance, overhead, G&A, and profit

- Pricing to Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations, including locating the correct wage determination on 

- Pricing base and option years, including wage escalation

- Pricing labor covered by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA)

- Working knowledge of the FAR as it applies to pricing (e.g., price reasonableness, price realism, lowest-price-technically-acceptable vs. best-value awards)

- Reading a solicitation's pricing instructions and price schedule (CLINs) and completing it accurately



Required: Tools & Skills

- Advanced Excel: complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and multi-scenario pricing models (2+ years)

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, defensible recommendations

- Excellent attention to detail, because pricing errors cost contracts

- Highly collaborative, with strong communication and interpersonal skills

- Ability to work independently with little to no training

- Ability to handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private home workspace

- Must pass a pre-employment background check



HIGHLY PREFERRED

- Security services pricing specifically (armed/unarmed officer posts, supervisory coverage, post hours)

- GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) pricing experience

- Price-to-win and competitor pricing analysis

- Experience with pricing or market-intelligence tools (e.g., GovWin, HigherGov, ProPricer)

- NCMA certification (CFCM or CPCM)



Interview Note: Finalists will complete a short pricing exercise.



WHY JOIN US

- Competitive salary, based on experience

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday schedule, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST

- A direct impact on contract wins and company profitability at a growing federal contractor



HOW TO APPLY

Please include short answers to these questions in your application:

1. Do you have pricing experience in the security industry or another service-based industry?

2. Have you priced federal government contracts (RFQs, RFPs, task orders)?

3. Have you built fully burdened hourly bill rates using Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations?

4. Briefly list the cost elements you include when building a fully burdened hourly rate.

This is not a social media posting or general VA role. You must have personally run paid campaigns for beauty businesses and be able to show results.



What you will do



Build, manage and optimize Google Search campaigns, including keyword research, negative keywords, bids and budgets.

Set up and fix conversion tracking with Google Ads, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, plus the Meta Pixel and TikTok Pixel.

Run Meta Ads campaigns for local customers, including retargeting and audience and creative tests.

Launch and manage TikTok Ads campaigns and find the formats that work.

Find ways to turn first-time customers into loyal, repeat customers, and to win back customers who have not returned.

Suggest new campaign ideas, offers and tests each month based on what you see in the data.

Track CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA and ROAS, and move budget toward what works.

Keep budgets, campaigns and reports clearly separated for each brand.

Send a short weekly report for each brand: spend, results, cost per result, and your recommendations.

Review landing pages, booking pages and the online store, and recommend fixes.

Monitor Google Search Console and Google Business Profile for each location and suggest basic SEO improvements.

Write ad copy and tell our team which images and videos you need.



Required



2+ years of hands-on paid ads experience, managing campaigns yourself.

Proven experience running paid ads for beauty businesses, such as hair salons, spas, beauty products or hair extensions.

Proven Google Ads Search experience with real budgets.

Proven Meta Ads Manager experience, including retargeting.

Working knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager for conversion tracking.

A track record of bringing your own ideas to improve results, not only running what you are told.

Comfortable reading performance data and explaining it in plain English.

Strong written and spoken English.

Able to work independently and manage more than one brand at once.



Preferred



TikTok Ads experience, especially for beauty brands.

Experience with businesses that have multiple locations or franchise locations.

Experience with local businesses that run on appointment bookings or recurring customers.

Experience with Shopify or e-commerce ads for beauty or hair products.

Experience with salon booking software, GoHighLevel or similar marketing tools.

Spanish (helpful, not required).

Looker Studio or simple automated reporting.



Schedule



Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Eastern Time, including a 1-hour break. Please check the time difference from your location before applying.



Engagement



Long-term independent contractor role. Paid in USD by Wise, Payoneer or EasyPay. You provide a reliable computer, stable internet with a backup, and a quiet place for video calls.



How to apply



 [hiring
] with the subject line Digital Marketing Specialist - [Your Name]. Include your resume and answers to the questions below. Applications without the subject line or the answers will not be reviewed.



Describe one paid ads campaign you personally managed for a beauty business: the type of business, the goal, the platforms, the monthly budget, and the results (for example, cost per booking or cost per purchase before and after).

Describe one Google Ads campaign you personally managed, with the same details.

Describe one Meta Ads campaign you personally managed, with the same details.

- Manage Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other assigned platforms.

**3. Newsletter &
 Marketing**

- Create additional event invitations, listing announcements, and targeted promotional
s.

 Ads

 campaigns and follow-up sequences.

- Present weekly ideas for videos, social media, lead generation, and client engagement.

**7. Additional Marketing Responsibilities**

title: Product Sourcing & Research Specialist
description:
Full time l 40 hours per week l EST



MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH THIS ROLE

SUBMIT YOUR RESUME, WHATSAPP NUMBER AND VOCAROO LINK



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Product Sourcing & Supplier Research

• Identify and research potential manufacturers, factories, and suppliers, primarily in China.

• Source products and components for multi-component product kits.

• Conduct supplier research through Alibaba and other relevant sourcing platforms.

• Identify multiple potential factories or suppliers for each product or component.

• Request quotations, product specifications, minimum order quantities, and production details.

• Compare supplier offerings based on pricing, product quality, capabilities, and suitability.

• Maintain a database of potential suppliers and sourcing opportunities.

• Provide recommendations on suitable suppliers for review and approval.

2. Product & Competitor Market Research

• Conduct product research to identify suitable products, components, and manufacturing options.

• Research competing products, market offerings, and product specifications.

• Identify differences between competing products, including materials, dimensions,features, and configurations.

• Gather relevant product information, images, videos, and technical details.

• Support the development of new products by identifying available components and potential manufacturing solutions.

• Present research findings in a clear and organized format to support decision-making.

3. Multi-Component Product Kit Development

• Research and source individual components required for multi-component product kits.

• Identify suppliers capable of manufacturing or supplying specific components.

• Compile detailed component lists based on the product requirements.

• Verify product dimensions, specifications, and compatibility between components.

• Coordinate the collection of product images, videos, samples, and other supporting materials.

• Track the development progress of each product and its individual components.

• Submit each completed development stage for client review and approval.

• Revise product research and sourcing details based on feedback.

4. Supplier Communication & Coordination

• Communicate with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain product information and quotations.

• Follow up on supplier responses, pending quotations, and requested product details.

• Clarify product specifications, dimensions, materials, and manufacturing capabilities.

• Coordinate requests for product samples, images, and videos.

• Maintain organized records of supplier communications and sourcing progress.

• Communicate effectively with the client regarding product options, sourcing updates,and development requirements.

5. Pricing & Preliminary Negotiation

• Obtain pricing quotations from multiple factories or suppliers.

• Compare supplier pricing and identify reasonable cost options.

• Review quotations to determine whether pricing is within an acceptable range.

• When pricing appears unusually high, conduct additional follow-ups to request revised quotations or better pricing.

• Support preliminary discussions with suppliers regarding pricing and product costs.



Important: Heavy negotiation is not a primary requirement for this role. The priority is to

identify suitable suppliers, obtain reasonable pricing, and develop products within the expected

timeline. More extensive price negotiations may take place later, once specific purchase orders

are being considered.



6. US-Based Product & Component Research

• Conduct sourcing and research activities for selected products or components available

in the United States.

• Review product dimensions and specifications for components that will be added to the

product kits.

• Determine how US-sourced components will fit within the overall kit packaging.

• Identify the amount of space required for additional components inside the box.

• Coordinate with the client regarding product dimensions, packaging requirements, andcomponent compatibility.

7. Product Tracking & Approval Workflow

• Maintain accurate progress records for every product being developed.

• Track each product through the client's designated product development workflow.

• Submit products for approval after each major stage, including:

o Initial product and market research

o Supplier identification and sourcing

o Component list compilation

o Collection of product specifications

o First-round samples, images, and videos

o Final sourcing recommendations

• Ensure that no product moves to the next stage without the required approval.

• Incorporate client feedback and reopen tasks for revisions when necessary.

• Maintain clear documentation of approved, declined, and pending items.



QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in product sourcing, supplier research, or e-commerce product development.

• Experience sourcing products or components from China.

• Familiarity with Alibaba or similar supplier sourcing platforms.

• Experience conducting product and competitor market research.

• Ability to identify and compare multiple suppliers for the same product.

• Comfortable requesting quotations, product specifications, and manufacturing details.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple products and sourcing projects simultaneously.

• Good written and spoken English communication skills.

• Able to communicate clearly with the client and suppliers, ensuring that instructions and product requirements are understood accurately.

• Comfortable working with product specifications, dimensions, component lists, and supporting documentation.

• Proactive, dependable, and capable of following through on assigned tasks.

• Willingness to work within a structured product development and approval process.



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience sourcing multi-component products or product kits.

• Experience working with Chinese manufacturers and factories.

• Familiarity with product development and manufacturing workflows.

• Experience coordinating product samples and supplier documentation.

• Previous experience in e-commerce, private-label product development, or import sourcing.

• Basic knowledge of packaging dimensions, product fit, and component compatibility.

• Experience using AI-assisted research tools or product tracking systems

What Is New Lead Standby?



New lead standby simply means being available to respond when a new lead comes in.

title: Insurance Business Development Specialist / Appointment Setter (Farmers Insurance)
description:
Job Overview:

We are a US based Farmers Insurance agency in Texas looking for someone who understands the insurance business, not just someone who can dial a phone. This role makes outbound calls, follows up with existing customers, and books appointments for our licensed insurance agent, but we are hiring for judgment and business sense first, calling skill second.



This is an outbound calling role, around 100 calls a day to existing policyholders, callbacks, voi
s, and new leads. Your job is to start a real conversation, understand what the customer actually needs, and book an appointment that sticks. You will not sell or quote insurance, our licensed agent handles all quotes, coverage discussions, and policies, but you do need to understand enough about how a P&C agency works to have a real conversation, not read a script. Prior cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting experience is required, along with P&C insurance experience from an agency such as Farmers, Allstate, Progressive, or similar. Farmers experience, including familiarity with Farmers eAgent, is strongly preferred.



We are not trying to fill this role with volume. We would rather pay well for one person who gets it than hire quickly for someone who doesn't.



Company: A Farmers Insurance agency based in Texas, offering auto, home, renters, life, and business insurance

Schedule: Full Time, US Central Time business hours, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST

Position Type: Long term, with room to grow

Compensation: $600 to $1,000 a month, open to more based on experience, plus commission on appointments kept



About the Role:

You'll make outbound calls through our VoIP phone system (Vonage), working through voi
s, callbacks, our existing customer book, and new leads. You'll reconnect with customers, uncover real needs like policy reviews, renewals, and new coverage, and book appointments on our agent's calendar that are worth his time. You'll collect basic customer information so every file is ready before the appointment, and you'll confirm each appointment ahead of time so it actually shows up on the calendar.



You'll be the first voice our customers hear, so clear, friendly, proficient spoken English is essential. You'll also handle customer information, so discretion and honesty matter as much as your calling skills. When something is unclear or a customer asks a coverage question, we want you to take a note and pass it to the agent rather than guess, this is part of understanding the business, knowing what you don't know.



Key Responsibilities:

• Make 100 outbound cold calls and follow up calls a day

• Generate your own leads when the call list runs low, by finding local businesses on Google and prospects on social media, and offering them a free, no obligation insurance quote

• Return voi
s and follow up on missed calls and past leads

• Book, confirm, and reschedule appointments on the agent's calendar

• Follow up with every booked appointment ahead of time to confirm it will be kept

• Collect basic customer information to prepare files before each appointment

• Log every call, outcome, and follow up in our CRM and call tracker

• Report daily call numbers and appointments set and kept to management

• Pass all coverage and pricing questions to the licensed agent



Required Experience:

• At least 1 year of cold calling, telemarketing, outbound sales, lead generation, or appointment setting, with real results, not just activity

• Experience finding and building your own lead lists, not just calling lists you were given

• P&C insurance experience with an agency such as Farmers, Allstate, Progressive, or similar. Farmers experience and Farmers eAgent familiarity strongly preferred

• Experience with GoHighLevel

• Experience calling US based customers

• Proficient English, spoken and written, with a clear and friendly phone voice

• Comfort with daily call targets and handling rejection

• Reliable internet, quiet workspace, noise cancelling headset, and backup power



Preferred (a plus, not required):

• Experience setting up and managing campaigns in GoHighLevel (workflows, automations, pipelines) is ideal

• Experience with VoIP systems like Vonage, RingCentral, or Aircall

• Additional CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, Mojo, Kixie, or similar)

• Experience with Google Calendar, Calendly, and Google Sheets



What We Are Looking For:

• Someone who understands how an insurance agency actually runs, not just someone who can dial a phone

• A confident caller who enjoys talking to people all day

• Genuinely positive, upbeat, bubbly energy, hardworking and coachable

• Consistent and self motivated, hitting call numbers without being chased

• Resourceful and self driven, someone who finds people to call instead of waiting for a list

• Someone who can show us real numbers: how many appointments you have booked and how many actually showed up

• Organized and detail oriented with call notes and follow ups

• Trustworthy with confidential customer information

• Reliable, consistent, and looking for a long term relationship, not a short term gig



Application Instructions (required to be considered):

To be considered, you must submit all of the following, with the subject line "Farmers Insurance Business Development":



1. Updated resume plus a 4 to 6 sentence summary of your cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience, including your insurance agency experience

2. List of all dialers, phone systems, and software used, including GoHighLevel (and whether you have set up campaigns, workflows, or automations in it, not just used it), Vonage, RingCentral, Google Voice, Excel, etc.

3. Years of experience calling US based customers, your average daily call volume, and your typical appointment show up rate

4. How you have found your own leads in past roles (Google, social media, directories, etc.) and roughly how many you generated a week

5. A 60 second voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a customer to book a policy review. This is not required but is a plus to get you invited for an interview.

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Property Manager
description:
Property Manager 

Job Description

GOPM

Department:

Property Management

Status:

Full-Time
