Remote



Summary:

Green Ocean Property Management (GOPM) is hiring a detail-driven and proactive Property Manager Assistant to support the daily operations of our property management team. In this role, you will be instrumental in maintaining tenant satisfaction, ensuring smooth leasing processes, and coordinating with vendors and internal teams to address property needs.



This is a client-facing, systems-heavy role that requires strong organization, responsiveness, and communication skills. You’ll handle the front lines of tenant communication, assist with maintenance logistics, and contribute to streamlined operational execution — all from a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Tenant Communication & Lease Management

Act as the primary point of contact for tenants — address inquiries, requests, and concerns in a timely, professional manner.

Assist in lease lifecycle management including drafting lease agreements, facilitating renewals, and processing terminations.

Manage rent collection activities, send reminders, escalate late payments, and help enforce payment terms.



Maintenance Coordination

Serve as liaison between tenants, property owners, and vendors.

Schedule and monitor maintenance and repair work orders using internal tracking tools.

Ensure follow-through and resolution of service requests; maintain a high standard of property condition.



Records Management

Maintain up-to-date digital records including leases, inspection reports, rent rolls, and maintenance logs.

Ensure compliance with state and federal property management regulations regarding documentation and tenant interactions.



Tenant Screening & Onboarding

Conduct background checks, verify employment and references for prospective tenants.

Assist in preparing onboarding materials and move-in documentation.



Move-In/Move-Out Support

Assist in the coordination of property inspections for both move-ins and move-outs.

Prepare condition reports and coordinate with vendors for turnover services.

Ensure timely processing of security deposit returns in accordance with regulations.



Reporting & Data Entry

Generate regular operational reports, including:

Occupancy/vacancy rates

Maintenance activity summaries

Rent collection status

Lease expiration schedules

Flag operational risks or trends proactively.



Marketing & Listings Support

Create or update rental listings on platforms such as Zillow,
 Marketplace, and RentRedi.

Coordinate with the leasing team to schedule virtual or in-person property showings.

Monitor listing performance and suggest optimizations.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with the property management, leasing, and accounting teams to ensure efficient workflow.

Escalate urgent issues while maintaining alignment with internal processes and SOPs.

Suggest process improvements that enhance tenant experience or team productivity.



Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years experience in property management, real estate operations, or virtual property assistance.

Knowledge of lease administration, rental laws, and maintenance coordination processes.

Ability to multitask across a high volume of properties or tenants.

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and professional customer service demeanor.





Technical Proficiency

Strong experience with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, RentRedi, or similar).

Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar) and Microsoft Office.

Comfortable using remote tools like Slack, Zoom, and project management boards (Asana, Trello).

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Market Research

Human Health Engineering, LLC

Remote, Philippines-based · Full-time with flexible working hours · Immediate start

Pay —$6–$8 USD per hour typical, up to $10 USD per hour for exceptional experience

Human Health Engineering (HHE) is a U.S.-based concierge wellness coaching startup focused on metabolic health. We’re currently in fundraising rounds, and this is a chance to get in on the ground floor, work directly with the founder, and help build the business.

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and delivers quality work. We value self-motivated, high-performing people and look to reward strong performance with greater responsibility and opportunities for promotion as HHE grows.

What you’ll do

• Manage social media and publishing. Maintain the content calendar, prepare and schedule approved posts on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Substack, and track which content gets meaningful engagement.

• Research the market. Investigate the size and scope of the markets for metabolic health, diabetes-related wellness, and wellness coaching. Identify relevant customer segments and summarize your findings with sources.

• Track competitors. Follow what coaches and wellness companies publish on social media and in newsletters. Compare their programs, services, and memberships, including public pricing and how they position their offers.

• Find affiliate and partner programs. Research opportunities with health and wellness wearable, supplement, and app companies. Compare product quality, fit for HHE clients, eligibility, commissions, and payout terms.

• Evaluate apps that let clients share data with their coach. Where possible, test apps from both sides. Verify what coaches can see with client permission, which devices connect, how easy the app is to use, and what it costs. Recommend a shortlist and explain which options are worth trying.

What we’re looking for

Experience managing social media or publishing channels, clear written English, and the ability to work independently. You should be able to verify information at the source, explain what matters, and make a recommendation. Familiarity with wellness coaching, wearables, supplements, or affiliate programs is helpful.

How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with a brief introduction, links or examples from channels you’ve managed, and one research summary or product comparison you’ve prepared. Briefly explain what you recommended and why. Include your earliest start date and your typical availability in Philippine time.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels/Shorts) – Nutrition Education Brand
description:
Short-Form Video Editor for a Growing Nutrition Education Brand



ABOUT US

Qualified Nutrition is a UK-based nutrition education brand. I'm Pete, a nutritionist working with professional boxers and the founder of QNC, a nutrition certification for aspiring coaches. We create evidence-based nutrition content and we're growing our presence on Instagram and YouTube. We're looking for a talented editor to help bring that content to life.



This is the start of something bigger. We'll begin with a small, steady workload, and as our platforms grow, so will this role. We're looking for someone to grow with us long term, not a one-off freelancer.



THE ROLE

- Starting with 2 reels per week (Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts). Volume will increase as we grow.

- Footage is mostly talking-head videos filmed on a DJI Osmo Pocket, with gym, food and fight-camp b-roll

- Finished reels are typically 60–90 seconds, occasionally up to 3 minutes

- I'll send raw clips via Google Drive with a short brief. You take it from there.

- Future opportunity: long-form YouTube editing as the channel relaunches

- Working hours are flexible and will be agreed together to suit the workload



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN AN EDIT

- A scroll-stopping hook in the first 2 seconds

- Tight, fast-paced editing with no pauses, ums or dead air

- Dynamic animated captions with key words highlighted

- Punch-in zooms, text pop-ups and b-roll to keep it visually engaging

- Subtle sound effects, with music that sits under the voice and never over it

- A clean, modern style that fits our brand (light blue, white and charcoal)



ABOUT YOU

- Proven experience editing short-form content for Reels, TikTok or Shorts

- A portfolio that includes talking-head edits

- Confident in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

- Good written English, so captions are accurate (including nutrition terms)

- Reliable and communicative, with a 48-hour turnaround per reel

- Creative: you suggest ideas rather than just following instructions

- Bonus: experience with educational, health or fitness content, or YouTube long-form



WHY WORK WITH US

- Long-term, consistent work with room to grow

- Creative freedom to help shape the look of the brand

- A friendly, straightforward working relationship

- Interesting, educational content, including insights from professional boxing



HOW TO APPLY

If you're interested, send a message through OnlineJobs.ph that includes:

1. The word "NUTRITION" at the top of your message (so we know you've read this)

2. 2–3 links to your current work, ideally talking-head reels you've edited

3. The editing software you use

4. Your usual turnaround time

5. One sentence on what you think makes a reel go viral



NEXT STEP: TRIAL EDIT

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a raw talking-head video to edit into a reel. This is your chance to show us your style and the quality of your work, and it will play a big part in our decision.

title: Remote Phone Operator (English-speaking calls)
description:
We are an appliance repair company. We are looking for a phone operator who will become a full member of our team.



We need someone to start as soon as possible.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

• Monday to Friday.

• 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM Los Angeles time (Pacific Time), 6 hours a day.

• $5 per hour.

• Remote work.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Access to our CRM system (where you see all calls, customers and bookings) and every other account you need.

• Clear instructions: what to say to customers and what to do in each situation.

• Training on your first day. We will show and explain everything before you start.

• A team chat with the technician, the owner and the manager. During your shift they are always available to help, train you and answer any question.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Answer every incoming call. This is our main rule. We pay for every customer who calls us. So when the phone rings, you pick up. The only exception: you are already talking to another customer.

• Book as many customers as possible. Your job is not just to take the call, but to book the customer for a repair.

• Call back if a call drops. Text the customer, offer a discount within our rules, reach an agreement — you do this on your own, without reminders, because you understand why it matters.

• Stay in touch with customers. When a customer texts or calls, you advise them and follow through to the end.

• Follow our instructions and rules.



This is more than taking calls. It is partly a sales role: you sell our service.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 6 months of experience in a similar role at a similar company.

• Good spoken English.

• Independent thinking. Our rules are simple, but you need to understand the reason behind them and use common sense.

• Motivation to work and earn.

• 100% attendance. You will be our only operator, so we need you available for the whole shift.



WHAT YOU NEED

• A headset (headphones with a microphone), so customers hear you clearly.

• A fast, stable internet connection.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this post. Write a few sentences about yourself and tell us when you can start.

title: SharePoint Administrator
description:

We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Administrator to assist with the design, configuration, and implementation of a multi-site SharePoint environment within Microsoft 365.



This individual will work directly with company leadership to assess business requirements, develop implementation recommendations, and configure a SharePoint environment that supports document management, file organization, internal collaboration, and secure information sharing across multiple departments or business units.



Responsibilities will include evaluating Microsoft 365 licensing requirements, recommending appropriate configurations, developing site architecture, and implementing approved solutions.



The consultant will be expected to provide technical expertise and recommendations while working within the project scope, requirements, and direction established by company leadership. All significant technical decisions, licensing purchases, architectural changes, and implementation plans must be reviewed and approved by the CEO before execution.

3. Administration, Permissions & Security

- Implement access controls for departments, teams, and individual users.

- Configure document-sharing policies and access restrictions.

- Apply Microsoft 365 security and data management best practices.

- Submit proposed changes affecting security, access, or organizational structure for approval before implementation.

- Document site architecture, configurations, permissions, and administrative procedures.

- Provide technical recommendations for ongoing SharePoint management and maintenance.

- Communicate project progress, technical considerations, and potential issues to leadership.

- Deliver knowledge transfer and guidance to designated administrators or internal staff.



Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and administering SharePoint Online environments.

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Office 365) administration.

- Proven experience building and managing multiple SharePoint sites.

- Strong understanding of SharePoint document libraries, lists, metadata, versioning, and permissions.

- In-depth knowledge of Microsoft 365 licensing structures, including Business and Enterprise plans.

- Strong understanding of access management, security, and document governance.

- Ability to independently complete assigned technical implementation tasks within an established project scope.

- Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively with executive leadership, provide technical recommendations, and execute approved solutions.

- Understands the importance of obtaining management approval before making significant architectural, licensing, security, or configuration decisions.

- Must be available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT). Availability during these hours is required for meetings, project coordination, and collaboration.

title: OA Sourcing VA — Amazon Canada FBA
description:
About the role



We are hiring one full-time Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing VA for a Canadian Amazon FBA business. You will find products at Canadian retailers that we can resell profitably on 
, check each one in Keepa and SellerAmp, and submit it as a lead to our shared lead database.



This is a volume-and-accuracy role. We need someone who can find 10 to 15 good leads a day, match listings correctly, and act on feedback the first time it is given. If you are used to submitting 3 to 5 leads a day, this role is not a fit.



Requirements

Please read each of these before applying. Applications that miss any of them will not be considered.

• Volume: 10 leads per day minimum, 15 per day target, within an 8-hour shift.

• Canada only: every lead must come from a retailer that ships from inside Canada. A .ca domain is not enough; 
 sites ship from the US. US-shipping leads are rejected.

• Accurate matching: pack size, count, size, colour and variant must match the Amazon listing exactly.

• Takes feedback: when we correct something, it should not need to be said twice.

• Experience: at least 1 year of paid OA sourcing work, with Keepa and SellerAmp. 
 experience is a plus but not required.

• Computer: desktop or laptop with 16GB RAM or more, Google Chrome as your main browser.

• Internet: 25 Mbps or faster, plus a backup connection (mobile data is fine).

• Exclusive: no other Amazon sourcing clients while working with us. Other part-time work must not overlap your shift.

• Hubstaff: time tracking runs for your whole shift, including the trial.

If you read this far, start your application with the word MAPLE.



Pay, hours and tools

• Pay: $4 USD per hour, paid weekly.

• Bonuses: performance bonuses based on profit per unit and margin become available after your first 3 months.

• Hours: 8 hours a day, 40 hours a week, tracked in Hubstaff.

• Tools provided: Keepa, SellerAmp and a VPN. You do not need your own subscriptions.

• Long-term: this is a permanent, full-time position on a growing team.



Hiring process

1. Application review: answer every question below in your own words. Generic or template answers are rejected.

2. Keepa graph test: shortlisted applicants get a Keepa graph screenshot and write a 4 to 5 sentence analysis. This step is required, no exceptions.

3. Paid 8-hour trial: one full 8-hour day, paid at the regular hourly rate. Hubstaff must run for the whole trial; untracked time is not paid. We will give you feedback on the completion of the the trial.

4. Offer: we d
 within a few days of the trial.



Application questions

Answer every question. Short, specific answers beat long ones.



1. What is your internet download and upload speed in Mbps? Attach a speedtest.net screenshot. What is your backup connection?

2. What computer do you use? Give the device, RAM, operating system, and confirm Chrome is your main browser.

3. How long have you done paid OA sourcing, for which marketplaces and categories, and which sourcing methods do you use?

4. What was your daily lead quota in your last OA job, as a number? Over your last month there, how many leads did you actually submit per day on average?

5. Are you working for anyone else right now (Amazon or not)? If yes, how many hours a week and when does it end?

6. Name 3 Canadian retailers you would source from that ship from inside Canada. Then explain how you would check whether a .ca website really ships from Canada.

7. An 
 listing is a 3-pack of a 400ml shampoo selling for $24. A retailer sells the single 400ml bottle for $5. Is this a lead? Walk through what you would check.

8. Give one real ASIN you sourced (any marketplace), with the buy price, the Amazon sell price, and why it was a good lead.

9. Describe a time you got the same correction from a client twice. What did you change after the second time?

10. Where did you work most recently, what was your role, and why are you leaving or why did you leave?

title: Experienced Credit Repair Specialist
description:
# NOW HIRING: Experienced Credit Repair Virtual Assistant (Full-Time | Long-Term)



**Company:** Quality Hands Business Consultant  

**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term  

**Work Schedule:** 40 Hours Per Week  

**Industry:** Personal Credit Repair & Consumer Credit Services  

**Experience Required:** Minimum 5 Years of Credit Repair Experience  

**Required Software:** DisputeFox, Google Docs & IdentityIQ



### About Our Company



Quality Hands Business Consultant is an established U.S.-based credit repair company with **6 years of experience** helping clients improve their personal credit reports and work toward their financial goals.



We are a very busy, consistently growing company with a steady flow of new and existing clients. **Generating clients is not our problem — we need the right person who can handle the workload and deliver quality service.**



We are looking for a dedicated, experienced, and highly motivated Credit Repair Virtual Assistant who understands the credit repair industry and takes pride in helping clients achieve positive results.



**Our company already has established systems, organized client information, and structured workflows in place.** We need someone who can step into our existing operations, follow instructions, maintain our organizational standards, and work efficiently without needing constant supervision.



**This is NOT a temporary or part-time opportunity.** We are offering a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position to a dependable individual who wants consistent work, stability, and the opportunity to grow with our company for years to come.



### Job Responsibilities



- Review and analyze personal credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information on credit reports.

- Prepare and manage credit disputes using applicable consumer protection laws, including the FCRA.

- Have experience disputing collections, charge-offs, repossessions, late payments, hard inquiries, and other negative credit items when legally appropriate.

- **Operate DisputeFox confidently and independently to manage client files, dispute rounds, and credit repair workflows.**

- Monitor client credit reports and track dispute progress through each round.

- Work with IdentityIQ and other relevant credit monitoring platforms.

- **Use Google Docs to create, update, organize, and maintain accurate client documentation.**

- Maintain neat, detailed, and consistently updated client records.

- Follow our existing organizational systems and ensure all client information is properly documented.

- Manage a high volume of active client files while meeting deadlines.

- Communicate professionally with management and provide accurate updates on client progress.

- Follow company procedures while maintaining confidentiality and protecting sensitive client information.



### Qualifications & Requirements



**We are ONLY interested in candidates with at least 5 years of hands-on credit repair experience.**



The ideal candidate must:



- Have proven experience working for a U.S.-based credit repair company.

- **Have previous hands-on experience operating DisputeFox. This is a mandatory requirement.**

- Be proficient in Google Docs and comfortable maintaining organized digital records.

- Have exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail.

- Understand the credit dispute process and relevant U.S. consumer credit laws.

- Know how to analyze credit reports and identify legitimate dispute opportunities.

- Be experienced in managing multiple clients and dispute rounds simultaneously.

- Be capable of following established workflows without disrupting existing systems.

- Have excellent time management and communication skills.

- Be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a consistently heavy workload.

- Be available to work **40 hours per week on a consistent, full-time basis.**

- Be self-motivated and capable of working independently without constant supervision.

- Have a reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work ethic.

- Be committed to accuracy, client satisfaction, and continuous improvement.



### Organization & Software Expectations



**Organization is extremely important to our company.**



We have already invested significant time into organizing our client information, documentation, and credit repair processes. Everything is structured and ready for the right person to take over their assigned responsibilities.



We are not looking for someone who needs to build our systems from scratch. We need someone who can maintain the organization we already have, follow our procedures, and keep client files accurate and up to date.



**DisputeFox experience is non-negotiable.** Candidates must already understand how to navigate and operate the platform. We are not looking to train someone from the beginning on how to use credit repair software.



### What We Offer



- **Full-time employment — 40 hours per week.**

- **Long-term, steady employment** for the right candidate.

- Consistent work with an established company operating for 6 years.

- A steady flow of client files and daily responsibilities.

- Established systems and organized workflows already in place.

- Opportunity to grow professionally as our company expands.

- Supportive management and clear expectations.

- Competitive compensation based on experience, skills, and performance.



### Who We're Looking For



We need someone who understands that credit repair requires **patience, consistency, attention to detail, and dedication.**



Our company stays busy, and there is always another client who needs our attention. We are looking for someone who can keep up with that demand without sacrificing the quality of their work.



**We do not need someone who simply knows how to send dispute letters. We need someone who understands the credit repair process from start to finish and can manage client files professionally.**

title: Supply Chain Manager (Fashion Ecommerce)
description:
We are a driven team. We move fast, we make decisions quickly and we build things that work. As we keep adding new stores and markets, we are looking for a Supply Chain Manager who wants to grow with us.



The Role

As Supply Chain Manager you make sure every order gets from our supplier to the customer's door as fast as possible. From the moment a customer orders, you own the process.

• Make sure all packages are shipped on time

• Make sure tracking numbers are added on time

• Make sure delivery times hit our KPIs

• Stay in daily contact with our suppliers and keep them moving

• Follow up on delays and fix problems before they turn into customer complaints



Solving Problems and Product Confirmations

Things do not always go to plan, and that is where you make the difference. You are in close contact with both suppliers and customers.

• Handle address changes and inform the customer

• Tell the customer when an item is out of stock and agree on the next step

• When a supplier cannot deliver an item, draft it on the store right away so we stop selling it

• Handle product confirmations: when a supplier reports that an item is unavailable but we have a close variant, you judge how big the difference is

• For small differences, such as a slight color difference, confirm it with the supplier or ask the customer whether they accept it, yes or no

You will spend most of your day in contact with suppliers and customers.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a high performer. Someone who takes pride in their work, holds themselves to a high standard and does not need to be chased.

• You thrive in a high paced environment and stay calm when things get busy

• You adapt fast when processes, tools, suppliers or markets change

• You learn fast and apply feedback right away

• You take ownership and finish what you start

• You communicate clearly, in writing and with the team

• You care about the customer and about the result for the business



Must Haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience in fashion dropshipping stores

• Hands-on experience with supplier communication, order fulfillment, tracking and delivery follow-up

• Strong written English

• Experience with Shopify-based stores

• Able to work independently and deliver consistent quality at speed



What You Can Expect From Us

We have high expectations of our team members, and you should have high expectations of us.

• Clear goals, clear SOPs and honest feedback, so you always know where you stand

• A team that moves fast and takes the work seriously

• Real responsibility and room to grow as the portfolio grows

• Leadership that is reachable, makes decisions quickly and keeps its promises

• Fair treatment and recognition for strong performance

If you want an easy, slow paced job, this is not the right fit. If you want to be part of a team that pushes each other to be better, you will fit right in.



How to Apply

Send us your CV and a short message on why you are a fit. Please mention your experience with fashion dropshipping stores, which suppliers and markets you worked with and how you kept delivery times under control.

Open question for you: add the application
 or form link, working hours and compensation before posting. Start your message with ''SCM'' so we know you've read the entire job post.

About Modern Edison Electric & the Role

Modern Edison Electric is a residential electrical contractor in Sacramento, California, owned by Scott Vogeli, since 2015. Our main offer is our Fire Safety inspection (the SafeHome Method): a careful look at a home’s electrical system to find hidden fire risks like old wiring, problem panels, and overloaded circuits. Homeowners get photos and plain-language answers. We also do panel upgrades, rewires, and EV chargers.

You are the first voice homeowners hear. Our automated dialer calls warm leads for you, and you pick up every call within 30 seconds. This is not just inbound: you will also make outbound calls to cold leads and follow-ups. You will book qualified Fire Safety inspections and other electrical appointments. All calls are recorded and reviewed. This is a sales role, not an admin role.



What You’ll Do

Answer ALL incoming calls from our automated dialer within the first 30 seconds.

Call warm leads interested in our Fire Safety inspection and other electrical services.

Make outbound calls to cold leads and prospective electrical clients, plus follow-ups.

Follow up with leads through the pipeline (calls, texts, and follow-up sequences).

Work closely with our team to refine scripts and improve conversion.

Hand off every booked appointment properly, with all the data the team needs.

Send a short end-of-day report in Slack.

Find ways to improve workflows and productivity on your own, and help us build and improve our sales process.





Compensation & Performance Bonus

Base pay: $5.00 per hour (about $867 per month on a full-time, 40-hour week).

Booking bonus: +$15 for every successful booking worth at least $2,500. (We define “successful” at onboarding.)

Paid leave: 7 days per year (after probation).

Sick leave: 5 days per year (after probation).

Maternity leave: 10 paid days (after probation).

Bereavement leave: 7 paid days for immediate family (spouse, parent, sibling, or child).

Paid holidays: New Year’s Day, Independence Day (July 4), Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day.

Free backup power station after 1 year of continuous work.

Benefits follow Modern Edison Electric’s current remote team policy and may be updated.



Schedule & Work Setup

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM Pacific Time. That is 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM Philippine Time (Nov–Mar) and 3:00 AM – 12:00 PM Philippine Time during US daylight saving time (Mar–Nov).

Equipment: a main laptop for your work.



Who We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

Excellent spoken English with a clear, natural Californian accent. California homeowners need to feel like they are talking to a local. This is the #1 requirement.

REQUIRED: At least 2 years of US-facing outbound sales experience (cold calling, appointment setting, and closing).

Booking appointments for a US electrical contractor.

GoHighLevel, Notion, or auto-dialer experience.

Basic knowledge of home electrical work. (We will train you.)

30-second pick-up: Every call picked up in 30 seconds or less.

Bookings: Qualified appointments set on our calendar.

Show rate: Booked visits that actually happen.

Clean CRM notes: Every call logged clearly, the same day.





How to Apply

Send the following:

1. Your resume.

2. A 1 to 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself and pitching yourself as if you were calling a lead for an electrical contractor.

3. Your experience level with GoHighLevel, Notion, or any other CRM.



Where to send it: reply through this job post, or
 everything to

What happens next: we review every recording first. Shortlisted applicants move to a short live role-play call on Pacific Time, a short paid test shift, a reference check, and a final interview. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

We hire for the long term. If you love the phone, hit your numbers, and want a steady, full-time role with a growing US company, we would love to hear from you.

Job title

Lightspeed Retail R-Series Inventory & Purchase Order Assistant



Employment type: Part-time, remote

Pay: $8 USD/hour

Hours: Approximately 5 hours per week to start

Job description

Aloha! Hulakai Surf and Paddle is a Hawaiʻi retail business with stores in Hilo, Waikoloa, and Kona. We’re looking for someone to enter new products and purchase orders in Lightspeed Retail R-Series using invoices from multiple vendors. We carry apparel, swimwear, accessories, and paddle gear. Many products come in multiple sizes, colors, or prints, so matching each invoice line to the exact variant is a big part of the job.

What you’ll do

- Review each invoice. Confirm the vendor, invoice number, invoice date, and assigned store. Check whether the invoice has already been processed or belongs to an existing PO. Flag revised invoices, partial shipments, and invoices that cover more than one store.

- Match existing products first. Search by UPC, vendor item number, SKU, and product name. Confirm the exact style, size, color, or print before using an existing item. When a match is unclear, flag it for review.

- Create new products and variants. Follow our naming, category, and pricing guidelines. Add new sizes or colors to the existing product matrix when appropriate. Enter the brand, vendor item number, SKU, UPC, and unit cost where provided. Ask us for any missing retail price, barcode, or product details needed to finish the item.

- Enter or update purchase orders. Use the correct vendor and store location. Enter the exact variants, quantities, and unit costs. Check whether the invoice lists individual units, packs, or cases. If there’s an existing PO and the invoice differs, flag the difference before changing the order.

- Reconcile your work. Double-check the quantities and merchandise subtotal against the invoice. Identify any differences caused by discounts, freight, tax, or credits and follow our instructions for handling them. Flag unexplained differences before marking the entry ready for review.

- Track what’s done and what’s pending. Log the vendor, invoice number, store, Lightspeed PO number, and status in our shared tracker. Include the specific invoice line and your question when something needs review.

What our store team handles

Our store team counts and receives the physical shipment. Your work ends when the items and PO are entered, checked, and ready for review. Send any backorders, substitutions, damages, shortages, or unclear costs to our team. Get approval before changing existing retail prices or barcodes, merging items, or deleting records.

What we’re looking for

- Hands-on experience with Lightspeed Retail R-Series is strongly preferred. If you’ve used another retail POS, tell us which one and describe the inventory and PO work you handled.

- You’re comfortable reading vendor invoices and working with product variants, wholesale costs, and pack quantities.

- You can use Google Sheets to track your work and communicate questions clearly in writing.

- You can work independently from written instructions and ask specific questions when information is missing.

title: Experienced Personal Virtual Assistant | Scheduling, Research & Follow-Through
description:
**Part-Time | 3–5 Hours/Week | Long-Term | $6–$8 USD/Hour**



ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a private individual seeking an experienced, proactive personal virtual assistant to help manage the administrative and logistical demands of my personal life.



This is not a business support, data entry, or traditional inbox management role.



I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of tasks from start to finish, solve problems independently, anticipate next steps, and follow through without constant reminders.



The goal is to delegate responsibilities confidently, not spend additional time managing the person I've hired.



RESPONSIBILITIES



**Scheduling & Phone Calls**

- Research and schedule personal and healthcare appointments.

- Call U.S. businesses, medical offices, vendors, and service providers.

- Ask questions, gather information, coordinate bookings, and confirm details.

- Follow up when calls,
s, or requests go unanswered.



**Research & Purchasing**

- Research products, services, and providers.

- Compare options based on price, quality, reviews, availability, and requirements.

- Present concise recommendations with verified information.

- Coordinate approved purchases, track orders, and resolve returns, refunds, and delivery issues.



**Personal Projects & Coordination**

- Research and coordinate service providers and contractors.

- Manage personal projects from planning through completion.

- Help organize travel, special occasions, reservations, and personal errands.

- Coordinate with third parties, track dependencies, and resolve unexpected obstacles.



**Task & Follow-Up Management**

- Maintain my Trello board with accurate statuses, deadlines, and next steps.

- Independently track outstanding requests and follow up until resolved.

- Provide weekly progress summaries highlighting completed work, active tasks, blockers, next steps, and decisions needed.

- Escalate urgent issues promptly rather than waiting for a scheduled update.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



**Proven Experience:** Prior personal or executive assistant experience supporting busy individuals, with examples of independently managing administrative responsibilities and projects.



**Independent Problem-Solving:** When something goes wrong, you investigate alternatives and propose solutions rather than simply reporting the problem.



**Initiative & Ownership:** You anticipate needs, identify next steps, and move tasks forward without waiting for repeated instructions.



**Efficiency & Reliability:** You work accurately and promptly. Straightforward tasks should generally be completed within 48 hours.



**Strong Communication:** Excellent spoken and written English, professional phone communication, and concise updates that clearly explain outcomes and next steps.



**Organization & Follow-Through:** You can manage multiple unrelated assignments, deadlines, and third-party dependencies without letting tasks fall through the cracks.



**Research Judgment:** You verify information using reliable sources, including when using AI tools. You do not present unverified AI-generated information as fact.



**Discretion:** You handle personal information carefully and respect confidentiality.



TOOLS & AVAILABILITY



- **Trello:** Required for managing tasks, updates, and follow-ups.

- **Google Workspace and Google Maps:** Familiarity preferred.

- **U.S. Calling:** Must already have a reliable system for calling U.S. businesses during Eastern Time business hours, at no additional cost to me.

- **Equipment:** Reliable computer, internet, microphone, and quiet workspace.

- **Schedule:** Approximately 3–5 hours weekly, with flexible working hours except when U.S. business-hour calls are needed.



HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER



I provide clear task instructions, relevant information, and access to necessary tools. I welcome thoughtful questions and clarification when needed.



Within agreed boundaries, I expect you to exercise judgment, investigate obstacles, follow up proactively, and keep me informed without requiring micromanagement. Purchases and significant decisions require my approval.



This is intended to be an ongoing working relationship, with an initial paid practical trial to assess fit.



TO APPLY



Please answer these three questions with specific examples from your actual experience:



1. Describe a real task where something went wrong. What did you do independently to resolve it, and what was the outcome?

2. Tell me about a time you identified something your client needed before they asked. What did you notice, what action did you take, and what was the result?

3. How have you managed multiple tasks with different deadlines, including tasks waiting on third parties? Share a specific example of how you kept everything moving.



I'm particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate resourcefulness, sound judgment, initiative, and consistent follow-through, rather than simply list administrative skills.

We're building something bigger than a construction company. Our vision is to create a nationally recognized wellness and lifestyle brand, one that people follow, trust, shop with, and genuinely want to be part of. Think The Skinny Confidential, Studio McGee, Ballerina Farm, and Dairy Boy, combined with real expertise in healthier homes and buildings.

Wholly Well Built: Healthier commercial and residential construction, consulting, and development.

You'll bring your creativity, marketing expertise, and initiative to develop ideas, execute campaigns, build systems, and drive results.







This is a hands-on position offering considerable independence, creative input, and ownership.



You'll manage our marketing ecosystem, strengthen our branding, develop commercial partnerships, and build the systems that turn brand exposure into customers and revenue.







We already have an Instagram marketing partner, so your responsibility is to ensure our various marketing activities work together effectively. We need someone who sees the big picture, understands the details, and knows how to move things forward.

- Maintain consistent, compelling branding across our website, newsletters, shopping platforms, and social channels.

- Research emerging American wellness and lifestyle trends, bringing fresh, imaginative ideas to our brand.

- Manage
 campaigns, newsletters, and automations using Flodesk or similar platforms.

- Plan campaigns, coordinate content calendars, and support product launches.

- Work alongside our social media partner to ensure consistent messaging and effective execution.

- Track marketing performance, conversions, audience growth, and revenue.



Affiliate Marketing & E-Commerce

- Manage ShopMy, Amazon creator storefronts, LTK, and other affiliate programs.

- Research and curate wellness, home, and lifestyle products that align with our brand.

- Create attractive shopping collections, gift guides, and promotional materials.

- Develop strategies to increase affiliate sales and commercial partnerships.



Brand Partnerships, PR & Media

- Identify and approach wellness, lifestyle, and home brands for collaborations and partnerships.

- Create partnership proposals, media kits, and pitches.

- Coordinate podcast guest appearances, PR opportunities, and speaking engagements for our founder.

- Help establish Kelsey as a recognized authority in healthier building and wellness.

Support our podcast, Journal, and wider media presence.



Marketing Management & Execution

- Translate strategies into practical plans, schedules, and deliverables.

- Coordinate projects involving our founder, construction team, and external creative partners.

- Develop case studies and marketing materials showcasing our construction expertise.

- Keep projects moving independently, identify opportunities, and follow through.





Who We're Looking For



- Strong interest in the wellness, healthier homes, lifestyle, and consumer products industries, with the ability to translate market trends into effective marketing campaigns. 

- We're looking for someone personally interested in healthier living who understands why Americans invest in their wellbeing, homes, and lifestyle.

- You should enjoy discovering exciting wellness brands, following US consumer trends, and understanding what makes a lifestyle brand desirable and successful.

- AI fluency: You already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools regularly for research, writing, planning, and content creation.

 campaigns, audience growth, and conversions.

- Initiative and independence: You generate ideas, solve problems, take ownership, and deliver results without constant direction.

- Entrepreneurial ambition: You're excited about building something substantial and growing professionally alongside the company.

- Experience with ShopMy, ManyChat, Flodesk, LTK, Amazon storefronts, influencer marketing, or brand partnerships would be highly advantageous.

- Previous experience with US wellness, lifestyle, health, interiors, or e-commerce brands is particularly desirable.





What we're offering:

- Expected Hours: 40 hours per week.

- Pay: $13 - $14 USD per hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

- Additional performance bonuses may be available based on agreed performance objectives. Bonuses are not guaranteed.

- Direct collaboration with our founder, helping shape the future of the brand.

- Remote work with a growing US-based company.

- An exciting industry combining wellness, lifestyle, construction, media, and e-commerce.





We're interested in talent, creativity, ambition, and results; not simply impressive job titles. If you have the skills, initiative, and determination to help us build a nationally recognized wellness brand, there could be an exceptional future here for you.







Why Join Us? Grow Your Career as We Grow Our Brand



This isn't simply another remote marketing position. It's an opportunity to become an integral part of an ambitious American company at an exciting stage of development. We want someone who can grow with us, take on greater responsibilities, and potentially progress into senior marketing leadership.







How to Apply

 what to test first.

 what to post for each brand and local audience. Write captions, create graphics and carousels, and coordinate short-form videos with our video team.

- Manage the calendar and report in ClickUp. Keep approvals and client branding organized, monitor comments and messages, and route inquiries to the right property team. Each week, report what went live, what drove action, and what you’ll change next. Reuse strong content where it fits and adapt it to the local audience.

title: SENIOR FINANCE & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION MANAGER
description:
SENIOR FINANCE & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION MANAGER



Remote | Philippines | Long-Term Independent Contractor

Initial engagement



Approximately 20 hours per week on average; occasional additional time as project needs require; six-month growth review



Gross compensation

First 90 days: USD $1,000/month ($500 twice monthly). After satisfactory 90-day review: USD $1,200/month ($600 twice monthly).



Reporting

U.S. Executive Management



Work arrangement

Remote, with agreed fixed weekly schedule and time tracking



About Us

We are a privately held U.S. business group with two principal segments: a largely virtual, automated supply-chain operation serving frozen yogurt stores across the United States, and a technology-enabled retail café. Our Pakistan-based accounting team manages extensive day-to-day supply-chain accounting; this role will provide management-level financial review and oversight requiring relatively limited weekly time. The café uses QuickBooks Online and integrated operating systems, with distinct accounting workflows that require initial setup, coordination and ongoing oversight. We also maintain several low-activity entities, including nonprofits, requiring periodic financial statements and reviews.



We plan to expand our retail operations, creating opportunities for this role to grow. Our hands-on CEO brings extensive U.S. business leadership and a finance and CPA-examination background, and will work closely with and mentor the successful candidate. Together with our affiliated technology and software team, we are building an integrated, globally distributed business supported by strong financial controls, automation and collaborative management.



Position Overview

We seek a seasoned, analytical and technology-oriented finance professional with strong corporate administration capabilities. Our existing accounting team performs routine postings, AP/AR and reconciliations, supported by cloud applications and automation. This role focuses on financial oversight, identifying problems, strengthening controls, coordinating administrative matters and advising management—not routine bookkeeping.



Key Responsibilities

• Oversee financial statements, accounting accuracy, month-end close, reconciliations, AP/AR aging, vendor credits, cash flow and accounting team output.

• Review banking, merchant/credit-card settlements, POS-to-accounting flows, payroll, expenses, purchasing and inventory-related financial controls.

• Prepare budgets, forecasts, variance analysis and management reporting; proactively investigate anomalies and recommend corrective action.

• Coordinate U.S. tax documentation, filing calendars, external CPA requests, audits and reviews; support timely compliance follow-through.

• Use QuickBooks Online, Excel and cloud systems confidently; assess integrations, automation, permissions, reporting controls and process improvements with IT.

• Coordinate corporate records, entity registrations, licenses, insurance, contracts, leases, franchise documents, legal notices and renewal calendars with qualified advisers.

• Support management projects and coordinate follow-ups across finance, operations, technology and external service providers.



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration or related field; 7–10 years of relevant experience including financial oversight.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting practices, internal controls, banking, merchant processing, financial analysis and cloud-based business workflows.

• Advanced Excel skills and practical QuickBooks Online experience; confident adopting automation, integrations and new technologies.

• Excellent spoken and written English; clear, prompt communication with colleagues in the U.S. and Pakistan and with outside professionals.

• Independent judgment, strong organizational discipline, confidentiality, initiative, problem-solving ability and willingness to grow with the business.

• CPA, ACCA, CA or equivalent credentials and multi-entity or U.S. business experience preferred; legal matters coordinated with counsel, not independently advised.



Schedule, Communication & Accountability

• Submit a fixed proposed weekly work schedule for management approval; provide at least 5–8 hours of agreed weekly overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours, with flexibility for meetings with U.S. and Pakistan teams.

• Maintain a dedicated, quiet, private workspace and reliable internet suitable for confidential calls and nighttime work. Disclose in advance any household, noise, connectivity or scheduling restrictions affecting evening meetings.

• Submit a daily written work and progress report, including completed activities, time spent, pending matters, blockers and next steps. Accurately record and substantiate all work using the company time tracker.

• Be reasonably available for occasional weekend questions or meetings when needed; most weekends are ordinarily free. Weekend work counts toward authorized hours unless additional time is approved.

• Disclose the number of other active clients/engagements, anticipated time commitments and any actual or potential conflicts of interest at onboarding; promptly report material changes. Other work must not compromise agreed availability, confidentiality or performance.



Compensation, Time Off & Growth

• Initial 90-day trial gross independent-contractor fee: USD $1,000 monthly, paid $500 on the 15th and $500 on the last day of each month. Following a satisfactory 90-day performance review, compensation will be increased to USD $1,200 monthly, paid $600 twice monthly. Fees are inclusive of all contractor compensation; no separate employment benefits are provided.

• The engagement is designed to average approximately 20 hours per week, with occasional additional time as project needs require. We seek a project-driven, results-oriented professional who takes ownership of deliverables, exercises sound judgment in balancing priorities, and does not approach the role with a strictly hourly mindset. Time tracking and daily reporting remain mandatory; material additional hours or changes in scope require advance management approval.

• Up to 10 working days of planned unavailability may be requested per year, subject to advance notice and management approval. No more than five consecutive working days may be taken without a separately negotiated exception. Any absence, including unexpected unavailability, must be promptly communicated; payment treatment will be agreed in advance where practical.

• After six months of hands-on experience, management will review performance, contribution, initiative, workload and business needs. Demonstrated results, a constructive mindset, teamwork and the ability to take on greater responsibility may lead to expanded opportunities and hours, potentially up to full-time, by mutual agreement; expansion is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements

Please provide your résumé, relevant professional credentials, experience with U.S. accounting and cloud systems, proposed fixed weekly schedule (Philippines time and U.S. Pacific Time), ability to work evening hours, current number of other clients, any conflicts or availability restrictions, and examples of financial or administrative improvements you have led.

title: Virtual Medical Assistant
description:
# Virtual Medical Assistant / Surgical Scheduling Coordinator



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Position:** Full-Time, Exclusive Employment  

**Start Date:** December 15, 2026  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time  

**Starting Pay:** $7 USD/hour, with opportunities for increases based on performance and value contributed.



### Job Description



We are a U.S.-based orthopedic spine surgery practice seeking a highly organized, professional, and technologically proficient **Virtual Medical Assistant** based in the Philippines.



We are looking for a dedicated, long-term team member who can independently manage patient communications, appointment scheduling, surgical coordination, and communication with other healthcare offices.



**Our two most important requirements are:**



1. **Exceptional English fluency:** Candidates must speak clear, fluent, professional English and be comfortable communicating with American patients, physicians, hospital staff, and medical offices over the phone.

2. **Full-time, exclusive commitment:** This position requires full-time dedication to our practice. Candidates must not hold other jobs or work for other clients while employed in this position.



Prior experience working as a Virtual Medical Assistant for a U.S. surgical practice is strongly preferred.



### Key Responsibilities



**Patient Communication & Appointment Scheduling**



- Answer incoming patient phone calls professionally and efficiently.

- Schedule, confirm, cancel, and reschedule appointments.

- Respond to patient messages, inquiries, and scheduling requests.

- Follow up with patients regarding appointments, paperwork, and outstanding requirements.

- Coordinate communication between patients, providers, and clinical staff.



**Surgical Scheduling & Coordination**



- Schedule surgeries with hospitals and surgical facilities.

- Communicate directly with hospital surgery schedulers and administrative staff.

- Contact primary care offices to request and follow up on preoperative medical clearances.

- Ensure necessary preoperative documentation, laboratory results, and medical clearances are received by fax before surgery.

- Track outstanding surgical requirements and proactively follow up to prevent delays.

- Communicate surgery scheduling updates to patients and clinical staff.



**Referrals & Medical Office Coordination**



- Contact referring physician offices to obtain referrals and necessary medical records.

- Follow up on outstanding referral documentation.

- Communicate with primary care providers, specialists, hospitals, and other medical offices.

- Maintain accurate documentation of communications and follow-up tasks in the electronic medical record (EMR).



### Required Qualifications



- **Excellent spoken English:** Clear pronunciation, fluency, strong comprehension, and professional telephone communication skills are absolutely essential.

- Excellent written English.

- **Full-time availability Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.**

- **Exclusive employment commitment:** Must work solely for our practice without maintaining other jobs or clients.

- Previous experience using electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) OR strong technological proficiency and willingness to learn new systems quickly.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage responsibilities independently.

- Proactive, reliable, and able to follow through on tasks without constant supervision.

- Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and appropriate equipment for professional phone communication.

- Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant for a U.S. healthcare practice.

- **Experience in a surgical specialty**, particularly orthopedic surgery, spine surgery, or another surgical practice.

- Experience scheduling surgeries and coordinating with U.S. hospitals.

- Familiarity with preoperative medical clearances, physician referrals, and medical documentation.

- Prior experience with U.S. EMR/EHR systems.

- **Experience using AI tools (such as ChatGPT or similar platforms)** to improve productivity, organize tasks, and streamline administrative workflows while protecting patient information.



### Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



- An exceptional communicator comfortable spending significant time on the phone.

- Proactive and persistent about following up with medical offices and hospitals.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple ongoing tasks.

- Technologically savvy and enthusiastic about learning new software and AI tools.

- Independent, resourceful, and able to solve problems without constant direction.

- Interested in building a long-term career with our practice rather than juggling multiple employers or clients.



We operate a modern, technology-driven medical practice and value employees who actively look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.



### Compensation, Schedule & Start Date



- **Start Date:** Tuesday, December 15, 2026.

- **Starting Pay:** $7 USD/hour.

- **Regular Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

- **Exclusive Full-Time Position:** Candidates must be fully committed to our practice and cannot maintain other jobs or clients.

- **Holiday Time Off:** The following dates will be observed as days off during the initial holiday period:

  - Thursday, December 24, 2026 – Christmas Eve

  - Friday, December 25, 2026 – Christmas Day

  - Thursday, December 31, 2026 – New Year's Eve

  - Friday, January 1, 2027 – New Year's Day

- Opportunities for pay increases based on performance, reliability, initiative, and overall value contributed to the practice.

- Long-term opportunity to grow into additional responsibilities as the practice expands.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. **Resume:** Highlight previous experience with U.S. medical practices, particularly surgical specialties.

2. **Relevant experience:** Briefly describe experience with surgery scheduling, medical clearances, referrals, EMR systems, or AI tools.

3. **Availability:** Confirm you can begin December 15, 2026, and work exclusively for our practice, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, without other employment or clients.

4. **Compensation:** Confirm acceptance of the starting rate of $7 USD per hour.

5. **Interview availability:** Provide your availability for a live video interview this week or early next week.



**Selected applicants will be invited to a live video interview to discuss their qualifications, assess English communication skills, and learn more about the position.**
